Draws a turret of ch1Enemy04Create in its structure's matrix: model 0x20003 at its place and angles, and finds its position on the play plane (pointToPlane). While it is in view and the structure's byte 4 is set, it files the turret's hit record in list 3.

The task of a turret of ch1Enemy04Create. At 0 hit points it calls enemyDestroyed, lowers its structure's count of turrets, plays sound 6 and ends. Else it runs its fire function. It ends with its structure.

Makes a turret of a ch1Enemy04Create structure in list 4 (ch1Enemy04TurretUpdate, ch1Enemy04TurretDraw): 10 hit points, a place on the structure, an angle and a fire function. Its hit attribute is 0x35 or 0x36, by the structure's color (hitInitRegistered).

A fire function of ch1Enemy04Create's turrets: once the structure's step is above 2, every 16 frames it fires a bullet of its color at angle 0x4000 (bulletFireAt1030c) with an effect sprite (effectFollowScaled). It also sets the structure's byte 5, so that ch1Enemy04Update plays sound 0x102.

A fire function of ch1Enemy04Create's turrets: once the structure's step is above 2, every 16 frames it fires a bullet of its color at angle -0x4000 (bulletFireAt1030c) with an effect sprite (effectFollowScaled).
Places a point on the fixed route of ch1Enemy04Create's structures by a distance from 0 to 1: once around the rectangle of x -21.5 to 21.5 and y -14 to 26.5, at z -5.

A node function of ch1Enemy04Create's tree: turns its part about x by an ease of the structure's counter at 0x90 over its first quarter turn. ch1Enemy04Create sets that counter to 0 and nothing changes it, so the part never moves.

A node function of ch1Enemy04Create's tree: moves and turns its part about x by eases of the structure's counter at 0x90. ch1Enemy04Create sets that counter to 0 and nothing changes it, so the part never moves.

Draws a ch1Enemy04Create structure: model 0x20000 through its node tree (enemyModelDrawEach), keeps the matrix for its turrets, draws model 0x20002 (variant 0) or 0x20001 (variant 1) on it, and while it is in view and byte 4 is set files its hit record in list 3.
Turns a ch1Enemy04Create structure by the stage path's angles and value (pathAngles, pathValue) and sets its z from the path's height (pathPosition).
The task of ch1Enemy04Later: once its controller's distance passes the value it keeps, makes a structure of variant 1 (ch1Enemy04Create) and ends.
Makes a task (ch1Enemy04LaterUpdate) that makes another ch1Enemy04Create structure on a controller's route once the route's distance passes a value.

The task of ch1Enemy04Create's structures. At 0 hit points it calls enemyKill, makes explosions, lowers its controller's count, plays sound 0x10B and ends. Variant 0 also makes a later structure (ch1Enemy04Later) while the controller's distance is below 0.725. While it lives, it plays sound 0x101, moves in to its place on the controller's route (ch1Enemy04RoutePlace), variant 0 turned by the path (ch1Enemy04FollowPath), and follows the route. When the controller's distance passes 1.45, it leaves, lowers the count and ends out of view. Shots of ch1Enemy04TurretFire0 make it play sound 0x102.
Frees the node tree at the removal of a ch1Enemy04Create structure's task.

Makes a structure in list 4 for a controller (ch1Enemy04Update, ch1Enemy04Draw): 120 hit points with hit attribute 0x35 or 0x36 by its second argument (hitInitRegistered), model 0x20000 of bank 2 with a node tree, and 8 turrets (variant 0) or 12 (variant 1) from the tables at 0x8C0D4B88 and 0x8C0D4AC8 (ch1Enemy04TurretCreate).

The task of ch1Enemy04Pair: after 302 frames it moves its two structures' route distances (0 and 0.5 at the start, wrapping at 1) and its total distance on by a speed that grows to 0.00125 per frame. It ends when its count of structures, 4 at the start, is 0, or once the scroll passes 7500.
A stage script's record function of chapter 1: makes a controller task (ch1Enemy04PairUpdate) and two ch1Enemy04Create structures of variant 0, with second arguments 0 and 1.
The behaviour of ch1SwayCreate's enemies: swings x about a centre by the sine of a phase that grows by its step, adds its y speed, and turns by its x move. It ends below y 0 once out of view.
Starts a ch1SwayCreate enemy: its centre, amplitude and y speed from record words 6 to 8, its phase from record byte 0x39 and its step from byte 0x3A.
Makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) that swings from side to side as it moves (ch1SwayInit, ch1SwayMove).

The task of ch1SwayWave: after 46 frames, every 16 frames it takes a step of a cycle of four. The first three steps each make a pair of ch1SwayCreate enemies at opposite swing phases: both of a random color, then one of each color, then both of the other color. The fourth step ends the task once the scroll is past 2150.

Makes a task (ch1SwayWaveUpdate) with a copy of the record at 0x8C0D4D58 that sends pairs of ch1SwayCreate enemies. ch1Enemy03PairWatch calls it when ch1Enemy03Pair's two enemies and the two that they make again are all destroyed before the scroll passes 2100.

The behaviour of ch1Sway2Create's enemies: as ch1SwayMove. At each half turn of a second phase, it masks the swing's phase with 0xFF00. The phase is always a multiple of 0x100, so this does not change the swing.
Starts a ch1Sway2Create enemy as ch1SwayInit does, with its second phase at 0.
A stage script's record function of chapter 1: makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) that swings from side to side as it moves (ch1Sway2Init, ch1Sway2Move).
The behaviour of ch1LineCreate's enemies: moves by its velocity, and ends after 61 frames once out of view.
Starts a ch1LineCreate enemy: its velocity from record words 6 to 8, its frame count at 0.
Makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) that flies straight (ch1LineInit, ch1LineMove).

The task of ch1LineStream: every 49 frames it makes a ch1LineCreate enemy at its start point and switches the color after every third. The start point's y moves by its step each frame, and the task ends when that y is below -40.

Makes a row of 8 ch1LineCreate enemies at the y of its first argument, from x -32 or 32 by its third, and a task (ch1LineStreamUpdate) that adds more in line with them. They move to the other side and in y by its second argument. Their colors switch every third enemy, by its fourth argument.
The task of ch1LineWaves: after 31 frames it starts a ch1LineStream every 48 frames at y 45 with y speed -0.2, on alternating sides. It ends once the scroll passes 6400.
A stage script's record function of chapter 1: makes a task (ch1LineWavesUpdate) that starts streams of ch1LineCreate enemies.
Starts chapter 1's first stage script, at 0x8C0D4D98 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it after the opening flight, right after ch1IntroEnd.
Starts chapter 1's second stage script, at 0x8C0D6214 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it.
Starts chapter 1's third stage script, at 0x8C0D7FC4 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it.
Starts chapter 1's fourth stage script, at 0x8C0D8990 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it.
Starts chapter 1's fifth stage script, at 0x8C0D98B4 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at scroll position 3650.
A node function of chapter 1's boss tree: keeps the node's matrix for part A (0x1C8) and a scaled and moved copy of it (0x288), which part A's charge particles aim at.
A node function of chapter 1's boss tree: while byte 0xFF is set, keeps the node's matrix for part B (0x208) and a scaled and moved copy of it (0x248).
A node function of chapter 1's boss tree: scales its part to nothing while part A is drawn on its own (byte 0xAD).
A node function of chapter 1's boss tree: scales its part to nothing while part B is drawn on its own (byte 0xFE) and is still on its node (byte 0xFF).
Draws part A of chapter 1's boss, model 0x30004, at its kept matrix while byte 0xAD is set.

While byte 0xFE is set, draws part B of chapter 1's boss, model 0x30003 at its motion's frame, at its kept matrix (0x208), and files its hit record in list 3 when byte 0xFD is also set. Once part B is off its node (byte 0xFF clear) and out of view, it clears byte 0xFE.

The draw of chapter 1's boss (ch1BossCreate): its body, model 0x30000, through its node tree (enemyModelDrawEach), its two parts (ch1BossPartADraw, ch1BossPartBDraw), its hit records and its glow sprites.
Sets the point at 0x48 from the boss's position and angle and the offset at 0x8C0DA234, scaled in x by its side and in y by a constant.

Sets point B (0x108) from the boss's position and angle and the offset at 0x8C0DA240, with its y scaled by 0.975. It sets the point at 0x114 for ch1BossUpdate's shock ring to the boss's x times 0.75, its y times 0.575 and z 20.

Moves chapter 1's boss on a figure of eight. It adds its step to its phase. Then it sets x to 12.5 times the sine of the phase, y to 20 plus 0.75 times the sine of twice the phase, and its angle to 0x8000 minus 3072 times the sine of the phase.

Makes chapter 1's boss's two helpers above it (ch1BossHelperCreate), from the records at 0x8C0DA24C and 0x8C0DA258 and in the colors of its arguments, resets their fire counters and plays sound 0x104.
Makes a charge particle (chargeParticleCreate) that moves into part A's scaled matrix (0x288), with flag 0x02 by its argument.

Breaks part A of chapter 1's boss: an explosion burst near it (explosionBurstFixed), sound 0x108, the bullets vanish (stageEvents 0x02), part A is gone (byte 0xAD 0), and the boss's motion changes to motion 0x0B.

The attack of step 20 of chapter 1's boss, in steps of its own. It fires volleys of 3, 4 or 5 shells by difficulty (ch1BossShellCreate), in the two colors in turn, with sound 0x106. After every 4 volleys, when the boss timer shows more than 10 seconds, it 4 times charges particles into part A (ch1BossChargeA) with sound 0x10E and fires a fan of 3 or 5 homing bullets by difficulty from point A (ch1BossHomingCreate) with a shock ring (shockRingFire) and sound 0x105. It breaks part A (ch1BossPartABreak) at 0 hit points. It returns 1 when a volley or the charges end with less than 3 seconds on the boss timer.

Counts frames in chapter 1's boss (halfword 8, which ch1BossHelpers resets). Once the count passes its argument, it sets the fire flag (0x01) of the second helper (byte 6) and of the first (byte 5) in turn, every 19, 13 or 7 frames by difficulty (the table at 0x8C0DA2DC plus 1).
Makes a charge particle (chargeParticleCreate) that moves into part B's scaled matrix (0x248), with flag 0x02.

The task of chapter 1's boss (ch1BossCreate), in 27 steps. It comes in, starts its music (sequencePlay 2) and a boss timer of 100 seconds (bossTimerCreate), and sends its helpers (ch1BossHelpers, ch1BossHelperFire). It fights with part A (white bullets from point A), then part B (black bullets from point B), for up to 1201 frames each, then with its body (ch1BossStep20). It plays sounds 0x101 to 0x109 and 0x10D. At 0 body hit points it explodes, stops sound 0x10E and makes its destruction (bossDeathCreate) 180 frames later. Else, when ch1BossStep20 returns 1 and the timer ends, it rises until its y passes 82.5, lowers the stage's lock (stageUnlock) and ends.
Moves chapter 1's boss's sound to its position (effectSetPosition), carries part B's matrix on when it is off its node, and steps the motions of models 0x30000 and 0x30003.
Frees the node tree at the removal of chapter 1's boss's task.
A node function of chapter 1's boss tree: files the body's hit record in list 3 while byte 4 of the boss is 0.

Makes chapter 1's boss in list 3 (ch1BossUpdate, ch1BossDraw): model 0x30000 of bank 3 with a node tree and its node functions, a body of 1200 hit points (1800 in a game with two players) and part A of 250, both white (hit attribute 0x35), and part B of 400, black (0x36), all with hitInitRegistered. Chapter 1's stage program calls it.
Draws a helper of chapter 1's boss, model 0x30002 of bank 3, and files its hit record in list 3.

The task of a helper of chapter 1's boss. At 0 hit points, or when its flag byte in the boss has 0x80, it explodes (enemyExplosion), plays sound 6 and ends. Else it moves to its place in 64 frames and can then be hit. It turns toward a ship (angleTurnTowardPlayer) until its flag has 0x40, then moves out sideways and ends out of view. When its flag has 0x01, it fires a bullet of its color along its angle (bulletFire) and clears the flag.

Makes a helper of chapter 1's boss in list 3 (ch1BossHelperUpdate, ch1BossHelperDraw) at a position and a place, with 240 hit points in the color of its argument (hitInitRegistered), driven by a flag byte of the boss.

Draws a shell of chapter 1's boss (ch1BossShellCreate): glow sprite 0x10A02, sprites 0x10900 and 0x10903 while their alphas (bytes 0x7C, 0x7D) are not 0, with flags by its color, and model 0x30001 of bank 3.
Makes a shell's explosion (enemyExplosion with kind 0x41) and 20 particles (effectParticles), and plays sound 6.

The task of a shell of chapter 1's boss. It flies from its start to its target on an ease and counts its time down, then bursts into spinning bullets of its color (bulletSpinFireAt) and ends (ch1BossShellExplode). It also explodes and ends at 0 hit points or when the bullets vanish (stageEvents 0x02).

Makes a shell of chapter 1's boss in list 3 (ch1BossShellUpdate, ch1BossShellDraw): it flies from a start to a target, with 20 hit points in the color of its argument (hitInitRegistered), and bursts after a time. ch1BossStep20 fires them.
Draws the burst of ch1BossHomingCreate's bullet (ch1BossHomingBurstCreate) with its alpha.
The task of a burst of ch1BossHomingCreate's bullet: lowers its alpha by 0x14 and grows its scale each frame, and ends when its alpha is below 0x15.
Makes a burst at a homing bullet of chapter 1's boss in its color, each frame that its hit record shows a hit (ch1BossHomingUpdate).
Draws a piece of the trail of ch1BossHomingCreate's bullet with its alpha.
The task of a piece of the trail of ch1BossHomingCreate's bullet: lowers its alpha by 5 each frame and ends at 0.
Makes a piece of the trail of a homing bullet of chapter 1's boss, at its position, in its color and with an alpha.
Draws a homing bullet of chapter 1's boss and files its hit record in list 4 (hitFile).

The task of a homing bullet of chapter 1's boss, as homingBulletUpdate: it slows by 0.05 per frame to 0.5, then turns toward a lagging copy of a ship's position, with a turn rate that grows by 12 per frame up to 0x1C8 for 60 frames and then falls by 12 per frame to 0. It leaves a trail (ch1BossHomingTrailCreate). Each frame that its hit record shows a hit, it gives 1 energy (playerAbsorb) and a push and makes a burst (ch1BossHomingBurstCreate). It ends outside x -32.5 to 32.5 or y -42.5 to 42.5, and fades out at 0 hit points or when the bullets vanish (stageEvents 0x02).

Makes a homing bullet of chapter 1's boss in list 4 (ch1BossHomingUpdate, ch1BossHomingDraw): white or black (0x11 or 0x22), 5 hit points, from a point at an angle and a speed, homing on the ship that targetPlayerIndex picks. ch1BossStep20 fires fans of them.
The task of ch1Bg00Create's model: ends once the scroll passes a position.
Draws model 0x40000 of bank 4 (S01_BG00) with the fog flag and the flags in its data (ch1Bg00Flags).
Sets the draw flags of ch1Bg00Create's model. ch1IntroCreate sets them to 1 and ch1IntroUpdate to 0.
Makes a task in list 0 that draws model 0x40000 of bank 4 until the scroll passes a position (ch1Bg00Update, ch1Bg00Draw), and keeps it at ch1Bg00Data for ch1Bg00Flags.
Draws ch1ScreenQuads' two quads over the screen: the first opaque and only while its counter is below 640, the second translucent. On a horizontal screen it turns them first (polygonTurn).

The task of ch1ScreenQuads: it moves the edge between its opaque first quad and its second quad, a 400 pixel fade to clear, left by 8 pixels each frame, and ends once the fade has left the screen. It also moves their color toward 200, 200, 200.
Makes a task in list 0 with two quads over the screen in the color 200, 145, 100 (ch1ScreenQuadsUpdate, ch1ScreenQuadsDraw). ch1OpeningUpdate makes it.
Draws models 0x40001 and 0x40002 of bank 4 at the camera's position, offset in y by its height (0xC, from -2000 up to -1500) and turned by its angles (0x14 about y, 0x10 about x), with the fog flag.

The task of chapter 1's opening (ch1OpeningCreate) in steps. Each frame it scrolls the textures of models 0x40001 and 0x40002. Once the scroll passes 2300 and then 2700, it eases its x angle to 0 in 300 frames (easeWord). 902 frames later it eases the stage's camera value (cameraOrbitOffsets[3]) to -17000, 7000 and 0 in turn, and from then on raises its height by 1 per frame up to -1500. 481 frames later it starts ch1FadeLevelIn, and 377 frames after that it makes ch1ScreenQuads, lowers the stage's lock (stageUnlock) and ends.
Frees the two blocks of strips (uvStripsFind) at the removal of the opening's task.
Makes the task of chapter 1's opening in list 0 (ch1OpeningUpdate, ch1OpeningDraw), with the strips of models 0x40001 and 0x40002 of bank 4 to scroll (uvStripsFind).
The task of ch1FadeLevelIn: raises the fade's level by a step each frame (fadeLevelSet) and ends at 1.
Switches drawFog to Ninja's fade (byte 4 of ninjaFadeLevel at 1) at level 0, and makes a task in list 5 that raises the level to 1 (ch1FadeLevelInUpdate).
The task of ch1FogFar: sets the fog's far depth to a fixed value each frame (fogTableSet).
Makes a task in list 5 that holds the fog's far depth (ch1FogFarUpdate). Chapter 1's stage program calls it at scroll position 1550.
Starts chapter 1's background: the opening (ch1OpeningCreate) and model 0x40000 (ch1Bg00Create). Chapter 1's stage program calls it at its start.
Draws a falling sprite of chapter 1 (ch1FallingSpriteCreate) in the color 200, 145, 100 at its alpha, turned against the camera's roll, at its size and angle.
The task of ch1FallingSpriteCreate's sprite: moves it down by its speed and turns it, and ends below a height.

Makes a sprite in list 2 (ch1FallingSpriteUpdate, ch1FallingSpriteDraw) with one of sprites 0x1020C to 0x1020F, at a random place in a range at the top, with a random speed and size, an alpha and a turn.

The task of ch1FallingSprites, by a frame counter. From its 65th frame it makes a falling sprite (ch1FallingSpriteCreate) every 32 frames until the counter passes 1200, then faster ones every 16 frames until 1696. Then it plays sound 0x100, sets the main light's color to 1, 1, 1, makes sprites every 16 frames at the four x positions at 0x8C0DA4FC in turn, and ends once the counter passes 1856.
Makes a task in list 2 that sends falling sprites (ch1FallingSpritesUpdate). Chapter 1's stage program calls it at scroll position 2600.
Draws the 4 models of the list at 0x8C0DA50C (modelListDraw), chapter 1's background of bank 5 (S01_BG01).
The task of ch1Bg01Create's background: every second frame scrolls the texture of its three strips (uvStripsScroll), and ends once the scroll passes a position.
Frees the three blocks of strips at the removal of ch1Bg01Create's task.

Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 1's background of bank 5 and scrolls the textures of three strips of its model 0x50002 (uvStripsFind). Chapter 1's stage program calls it through ch1Bg01CreateJump.
Jumps to ch1Bg01Create (a stub of mov.l and jmp). Chapter 1's stage program calls it.
Draws model 0x80000 of bank 8 (S01_BG02B) with the fog flag and the model list at 0x8C0DA5AC (modelListDraw).
The task of ch1Bg02bCreate's background: scrolls the texture of its strips in v each frame (uvStripsScroll), and ends once the scroll passes a position.
Frees the block of strips at the removal of ch1Bg02bCreate's task.
Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 1's background of bank 8 and scrolls the texture of strips of its model 0x80000 (uvStripsFind).

Draws model 0x60001 of bank 6 (S01_BG02) 4 times, each 160 further in -z, from a z on a grid of 160 near the path's z, and 7 times past scroll position 6750. Past that position it also draws model 0x60002 at z -6250.
The task of ch1Bg02Create's background: ends once the scroll passes a position.
Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 1's background of bank 6 (ch1Bg02Update, ch1Bg02Draw).

The draw of lensFlareCreate's task, while the light's direction lies less than 0.6 from (0, 0, -1): the light, sprite 0x10900, in that direction, and 10 flare sprites from the table at 0x8C0DA5D4 (sprite, offset, size, flags, color). The flares take an eighth of the alpha in byte 1 and fade out as that distance grows from 0.4 to 0.6.
The task of lensFlareCreate: runs its callback, then places the light in the direction of its two angles, turned against the camera's angles.
The first callback of chapter 1's first lens flare (ch1Flare1): sets its angles to 0xF680 and 0xA180.

The callback at each frame of chapter 1's first lens flare: from frame 176 it fades the flare out by 16, at frame 190 it sets alpha 1 and then fades the flare in by 16 to 255, and it ends the task after frame 300.
Makes chapter 1's first lens flare (lensFlareCreate with ch1Flare1Init, ch1Flare1Update). ch1IntroUpdate calls it when its start wait of 60 frames ends.
Starts chapter 1's backgrounds of banks 8 and 6 (ch1Bg02bCreate, ch1Bg02Create). Chapter 1's stage program calls it.

Draws chapter 1's last background: model 0x70000 of bank 7 (S01_BG03) 4 times in a row, each 100 higher and 200 further in -z, moved by the task's offset. While the camera value cameraOrbitOffsets[3] is outside -0x1800 to 0x1800, it draws 5 of them and model 0x80000 of bank 8 below the camera. All draws use the fog flag.
Fades the lights to the values of chapter 1's boss area in 90 frames (lightsFadeTo).
Fades the fog from black, with both depths at -350, to color 255, 160, 100 and near depth -220 in 300 frames (fogFadeTo).
Fades the lights and the fog to chapter 1's boss area (ch1BossLightFade, ch1BossFogFade).

The task of ch1Bg03Create's background: moves its offset by its speed, wrapped at 200. From scroll position 7500 the speed rises to 4, then falls to 2. Once byte 15 of stageLocks is 0, it fades the lights and the fog for the boss (ch1BossLightFog), then swings the camera value cameraOrbitOffsets[3] on a sine.
Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 1's last background (ch1Bg03Update, ch1Bg03Draw).
The first callback of chapter 1's second lens flare (ch1Flare2): sets its angles to 0x800 and 0xC700.
The callback at each frame of chapter 1's second lens flare: ends the task after frame 600.
Makes chapter 1's second lens flare (lensFlareCreate with ch1Flare2Init, ch1Flare2Update).
Starts the second lens flare (ch1Flare2) and the last background (ch1Bg03Create). Chapter 1's stage program calls it at scroll position 7000.
Draws sprites 0x40100 to 0x40102 of bank 4 at the alpha in byte 0x0F (ch1Bank4Sprites).
The task of ch1Bank4Sprites: fades the sprites in by 15 a frame to 255 and holds them until frame 182, counted from the task's start. Then it fades them out by 15 a frame and ends at alpha 0.
Makes a task in list 0 that shows sprites 0x40100 to 0x40102 of bank 4 (ch1Bank4SpritesUpdate, ch1Bank4SpritesDraw) and plays sound 0x109. ch1IntroCreate calls it.
Draws a glow sprite 0x10A02 of ch1IntroGlow at its alpha, turned flat.
The task of ch1IntroGlow: moves its z by its speed and ends below 0.
Makes a glow sprite in list 0 (ch1IntroGlowUpdate, ch1IntroGlowDraw) at a random place in a range, at a z and with a random speed, at an alpha. ch1IntroUpdate makes them.
Starts a vibration pattern on a player's controller (vibrationStart), for ch1IntroUpdate.

Sets the scroll's position and speed for the stage after chapter 1's opening flight, the camera's flat mode, places the ships in the game at their start height with a turn effect (playerTurnEffect), and lets players join (joinLocked). Chapter 1's stage program calls it.

The task of chapter 1's opening flight (ch1IntroCreate) in steps. After a wait of 60 frames it starts the first lens flare (ch1Flare1) and fades the screen in. Then each frame it moves the camera's target view along the flight's path (pathAt). At set distances along the path it plays sound 0x10, starts the scroll, places the ships, eases them into place (easeFloat) and stops joining. Outside the attract demo it then starts music sequence 1 at a changed speed and vibrates each player's controller (ch1IntroVibrate). It gives the view back to the stage (cameraTargetRelease) and lowers the stage's lock (stageUnlock) once that ends. At set frames it changes the fog and the lights (lightsMix, lightAdd) and makes glows and charge particles (ch1IntroGlow, chargeParticleCreate). It ends at frame 500.
Draws chapter 1's opening flight's glow sprites while its size at 0x70 is above 0: 0x10900 at the alpha in byte 0x69, two 0x10A01 at half that alpha, 0x10800, and 0x10903 while byte 0xE8 is set.
Frees the flight's path (pathFree) at the removal of chapter 1's opening flight task.

Starts chapter 1's opening flight: sets the camera's mode to 0, the mode of playerDrawOnPath, makes a task in list 5 (ch1IntroUpdate, ch1IntroDraw) with its own path from the points at 0x8C0DA6A8 (pathCreate) and a start wait of 60 frames, and gives the camera the target view on that path (cameraTargetSet). It also calls ch1Bg00Flags with 1 and makes ch1Bank4Sprites. Chapter 1's stage program calls it at its start.

Draws one ship of ch1ShipsSequence that takes part, at the sequence's place and angles for it, keeps that matrix for its side effects, and draws the ship's model (shipModelDraw) while the ship's state is below 3 (new life, fly-in or in play) and forced flag 0x04 is set.
The draw of ch1ShipsSequence: both ships (ch1ShipsDrawOne).
Moves one ship of ch1ShipsSequence from its start to its target place and angles by the cosine of the sequence's phase (pointBlendCos), or puts it at the target once the phase reaches 0x8000.
Moves both ships of ch1ShipsSequence (ch1ShipsBlendOne), and returns 1 once the phase reaches 0x8000.
Makes a shock ring (shockRingCreate, 31 segments) at a ship of ch1ShipsSequence, with a texture by its argument.
Makes a second kind of shock ring (shockRingCreate) at a ship of ch1ShipsSequence, with a texture by its argument.

Step 0 of ch1ShipsSequence for one ship: when it takes part, makes and keeps its two side effects (shipSideEffectCreate) and sets its first move to a target from the table at 0x8C0DA778. It sets forced flag 0x04 in any case.
Step 1 of ch1ShipsSequence for one ship: slows the ship down to speed 0 by a step, and keeps its position as the start of its next move.

Step 2 of ch1ShipsSequence for one ship: sets its next move from its place and angles to a place from the table at 0x8C0DA798 at angles 0x1000, 0 and one from the table at 0x8C0DA7B0, by its order, and moves its two side effects on (byte 0x27).

Step 3 of ch1ShipsSequence for one ship: rolls the ship and raises its target each frame. On frame 8 of the step, or 38 for order 1, it makes a shock ring in the ship's polarity (ch1ShipsRing1). 24 frames later it makes a second (ch1ShipsRing2), ends the first, moves both side effects on and plays sound 0x11.

Step 4 of ch1ShipsSequence for one ship: rolls the ship, turns it about x up to 0x4000 and moves it up by 0.5 each frame. On frame 60 of the step it sets its next move to x -10 for ship 0 or 10 for ship 1, y -12.5 and z 0.

The task of ch1ShipsSequence in steps (ch1ShipsStart, ch1ShipsSlow, ch1ShipsTargetSet, ch1ShipsRings, ch1ShipsTurn and ch1ShipsBlend for both ships). It sets the speed of the sequence in slot 0 to 0 (sequenceSetSpeed). At its end, once a ship's first side effect has ended, it puts the ship at its place with a turn effect (playerTurnEffect). Then it clears the ships' forced flags and input (playerClearInput), sets their hp to 1, lets players join again and ends.

Makes a task in list 2 that takes both ships through a sequence (ch1ShipsSequenceUpdate, ch1ShipsDraw), with the player of the higher score first in a game with two players. It sets the ships' forced flags 0x02 (no buttons), 0x08 (invulnerable) and 0x20 (field off), clears their shot, switch and release input, stops joining and sets stageEvents 0x0A. Chapter 1's stage program calls it at scroll position 2125.
Loads bank 2 under the name S02_OBJ00 from the file list at 0x8C0E10B0, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 3 under the name S02_OBJ01 from the file list at 0x8C0E10F4, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 4 under the name S02_BG00 from the file list at 0x8C0E1230, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 5 under the name S02_BG00B from the file list at 0x8C0E12C8, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 6 under the name S02_BG01 from the file list at 0x8C0E1378, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 4 under the name S02_BOSS from the file list at 0x8C0E13DC, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads banks 2 (S02_OBJ00) and 4 (S02_BG00) at once and banks 5 (S02_BG00B) and 6 (S02_BG01) over frames. Chapter 2's stage program calls it at its start.
Loads bank 3 (S02_OBJ01) over frames. Chapter 2's stage program calls it.
Frees bank 4 (bankFree). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 18000.
Frees bank 5 (bankFree). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 19600.
Loads banks 2 (S02_OBJ00), 3 (S02_OBJ01) and 6 (S02_BG01) at once. Chapter 2's stage program calls it.
Frees banks 2 and 3 (bankFree). Chapter 2's stage program calls it.
Loads bank 6 (S02_BG01) at once and bank 4 (S02_BOSS) over frames. Chapter 2's stage program calls it.

Sets chapter 2's light (its two angles, color, intensity and ambient, and for the multi-light models the color of light 1 and three more values), and the fog's color to 128, 180, 205, its depths (fogTableSet) and the fade's level 0, with byte 4 of ninjaFadeLevel at 0, and sets fogFadeOn. Chapter 2's stage program calls it at its start.
Fades the fog to a setting in 360 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 800.
Fades the fog to a setting in 60 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 2's stage program calls it.
Fades the lights to angles 0x9900 and 0x4000 with color 1, 1, 1 in 300 frames (lightsFadeTo). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 17750.
Fades the fog to a setting in 300 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 2's stage program calls it.

Sets the light that ch2LightFade fades to, the fog's color to 128, 170, 205, its depths (fogTableSet) and the fade's level 0.5, with byte 4 of ninjaFadeLevel at 0, and sets fogFadeOn. Chapter 2's stage program calls it at the start of its second part.
Starts chapter 2's music (sequencePlay 3) outside the attract demo, and plays sound 0x10B. Chapter 2's stage program calls it at its start.
Fades the music of sequence slot 0 out (sequenceSetVolume to -127 over 10000). Chapter 2's stage program calls it.
Plays sound 0x3A (soundPlay). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 14350.
Shows the left band with bank 4's sprites 0x40000 to 0x40003 (leftBandCreate). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 15125.

The task of ch2SceneryPolygon: ends when its owner's removal starts or the owner's hit points are 0. Else, only while the owner is below y 40, it turns its polygon by the owner's angle at 0x20 when its flag is set (polygonRotate) and adds it to the scenery at the owner's position (sceneryAdd).

Makes a task in list 1 that adds a polygon of 4 corners from a table to the scenery at an owner's position each frame (ch2SceneryPolygonUpdate), turned by the owner's angle when its argument is set (polygonRotate).
Draws a gun of chapter 2 (ch2GunCreate), model 0x30004 of bank 3, at its place and angle.
Places a gun of chapter 2 on its owner: at the owner's position plus its offset from the table at 0x8C0DB434, turned by the owner's angle plus its own, and finds its muzzle point.

The task of a gun of chapter 2: follows its owner (ch2GunPlace) and, at frames that its mask picks and while its y is above a value, fires a spinning bullet of its color from its muzzle (bulletSpinCreate) with a flash. It ends with its owner.
Makes a gun in list 4 (ch2GunUpdate, ch2GunDraw) on an owner, at the place of an index into the table at 0x8C0DB434, in a color and with a mask for its firing frames.
Draws a ch2BlockCreate block, its model at its motion's frame, and files its hit record in list 3 when it has model 0x30003 and is below the height at 0x78.

The task of ch2BlockCreate's blocks. A block with model 0x30003 puts its hit points in the gauge when it is the object hit (hpGaugeSet), and at 0 hit points it sets byte 0x69. At its next update it then makes its death bullets (enemyDeathBullets), counts the kill for the chain, makes an explosion burst (explosionBurst), plays sound 0x114 and ends. Until then it runs its behaviour at 0x74 each frame, ends when that returns nonzero, and steps its motion.

Makes a block of chapter 2 in list 3 with 20 hit points and a scenery polygon that shots and ships collide with (ch2SceneryPolygon). With record byte 0x38's bit 1 clear it has model 0x30003, turned half a turn about x by bit 0, else model 0x30005 without homing lasers' aim (enemyInitUnaimed). Any nonzero byte 0x38 makes it black (enemyInitCommon). The caller sets its behaviour at 0x74.
A behaviour of ch2BlockCreate's blocks: moves by the velocity, and ends the block once it is out of view below or beside the play area.
Makes a ch2BlockCreate block that moves with the record's velocity (ch2BlockMove).
Makes a ch2BlockSpawn block and, with its argument set, two guns on it (ch2GunCreate, places 9 and 11).

The task of ch2BlockStream: moves its start point's y by its step each frame and ends once it is below -50. At frames that its mask picks it makes a block there (ch2BlockSpawnGuns), the first time also five more ahead, one interval of travel apart. Pattern 0 in bits 1 and 2 of record byte 0x38 alternates their colors.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a task (ch2BlockStreamUpdate) that sends blocks sideways at the speed at 0x1C from x -34.5 or 34.5 and a y that moves by the float at 0x18. Record byte 0x38 gives the side (bit 0 right), colors (bits 1, 2) and guns (bit 7).
The behaviour of ch2EscortCreate's enemies: moves in from its side to x 11.5 or -11.5, then falls at 0.25. On the 155th frame after that it leaves toward its side at 0.25 and ends once out of view.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) at a place, in a color, moving in from its side (ch2EscortMove).

The task that ch2BlockArmed makes for type 6: when the block's removal starts, makes two black ch2EscortCreate enemies 11.5 above it at x 35 and 50, negative for a block at x 0 or less, and ends. It ends without them once the block is below y -20.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a ch2BlockSpawn block with guns (ch2GunCreate) by the type in record byte 0x39, with one more gun of the other color on normal and hard for types 1 and 2. Type 6 also makes two enemies when the block is destroyed (ch2EscortWait).
A behaviour of ch2BlockFall's blocks: sinks by 0.15 each frame and moves as ch2BlockMove.
Makes a ch2BlockCreate block with the record's velocity that also sinks (ch2BlockFallMove), and on hard six guns on it for record color bits below 2.

The behaviour of ch2DropCreate's enemies: moves in from the side to x 22.5 or -22.5, then falls at 0.25. When it meets the scenery (sceneryHit) it explodes (enemyExplosion), plays sound 0x11B and ends. While it falls it also ends once out of view.

Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) in a color at y 30 and x 5 plus the absolute value of its float argument, negated for side 0, that moves in and falls onto the scenery (ch2DropMove).

The task of ch2BlockFalls: once a value moving from 0 by its step reaches -46, it makes nine sinking blocks (ch2BlockFall) 128 frames apart, with record byte 0x38 at 0, 2, 1, 2 in turn, then ends. Each block with byte 2 adds five ch2DropCreate enemies on both sides.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a task (ch2BlockFallsUpdate) that sends sinking blocks with falling enemies.
A behaviour of ch2BlockSpin's blocks: turns by the step of its data, half of it on easy, and moves as ch2BlockMove.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a ch2BlockCreate block with the record's velocity that turns by record byte 0x3A times 16 each frame, the other way when byte 0x3B is set (ch2BlockSpinMove). Byte 0x39 0 gives four guns of the color in bit 0 of byte 0x38, 1 two of them in the other color, other values none.
Sets an enemy's velocity from its angle and a speed (vectorFromAngle).

The behaviour of ch2Hunter1Create's enemies. It fires one bullet of its color at a ship at its 16th frame (bulletFire, aimAtPlayer with 2) and flies straight for its time. Then it turns toward its ship's kept position, which moves 5% of the way to the ship each frame, with a turn rate that grows by 8 each frame to 0x120 (angleTurnToward). It keeps the full rate for 261 frames or until its leader's removal starts, then lowers it by 16 each frame and ends once out of view. Its speed swings between 0.5 and 0.75.

Makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) that flies at its angle and turns toward the ship of targetPlayerIndex (ch2Hunter1Move), its time from record byte 0x39 and a leader from its argument.

The behaviour of ch2LooperCreate's enemies: at its 18th frame it fires one bullet of its color at a ship (bulletFire, aimAtPlayer with 2). Then it turns toward the point 0, 0 (angleTurnToward) with a turn rate that grows by 8 each frame to 0x120, stays there for 243 frames and then falls by 16 each frame. After the shot it ends once out of view.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) that flies at its angle and turns (ch2LooperMove).

The task of ch2Hunter1Wave: every 21 frames it makes two ch2Hunter1Create enemies of opposite colors, with itself as their leader, on sides that swap each time. After two pairs it skips one turn and swaps the colors. It ends once the scroll position passes 10100.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a task (ch2Hunter1WaveUpdate) that sends waves of ch2Hunter1Create enemies, starting after 20 frames.

The behaviour of ch2SwerveCreate's enemies: it moves by its velocity. Once below the height in its record's float at 0x1C, it speeds up sideways by 0.01 each frame, to the right when record byte 0x39 is set, and its y speed rises by 0.0125 each frame to at most -0.1, so its fall slows to 0.1. It rolls by its x speed and from then on ends once out of view.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) that flies at its angle and swerves away (ch2SwerveMove), its direction from record byte 0x39.

The behaviour of ch2SlowCreate's enemies: moves down at the speed of record word 6. After 122 frames it multiplies its y speed by 0.95 each frame for 361 frames, then speeds up sideways by 0.0125 a frame, toward negative x when record byte 0x39 is 0, else toward positive x. It never ends the enemy itself.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) that comes down, slows and moves aside (ch2SlowMove), its direction from record byte 0x39.

Places an enemy on a ring about its data's centre: at its ring angle (data 0x1C), at the radius at data 0x10 plus the argument times the sine of a phase that grows by 0x180 at each call, at the centre's z.

The behaviour of ch2RingACreate's enemies: they turn on their ring (ch2RingPlace). Kinds 0 and 1 pulse the radius and lower the centre 0.1 a frame. Kind 0 ends below y 0 out of view. Kind 1 stops falling below y 2, and 401 frames later widens the ring until out of view. Kind 2 shrinks the radius through the centre and ends past x 30 or y 40, or explodes on the scenery (sound 0x11B).

A stage script's record function of chapter 2 that ch2RingAWave also calls: makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) on a ring of record word 6's radius about the record's position (ch2RingPlace, ch2RingAMove). Record bytes 0x39 to 0x3C give its angle and turn, byte 0x3D reverses the turn, and byte 0x3F gives its kind.

The behaviour of ch2RingBCreate's enemies: they turn on their ring (ch2RingPlace), and its radius eases from 40 above record word 6 to it in 171 frames. At the camera's flat mode they switch their draw to enemyModel3Draw, wait 750 frames, then widen the ring until out of view.
The draw of ch2RingBCreate's enemies until the camera's flat mode (ch2RingBMove): enemyModel3Draw from a unit matrix, turned for a vertical screen.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes an enemy with model 0x10003 that turns on a ring about the record's position (ch2RingBMove, ch2RingBDraw), with the radius of record word 6, its angle and turn from record bytes 0x39 to 0x3C, and the turn reversed by byte 0x3D.
Makes 12 ch2RingACreate enemies from a record, about 0x1555 apart on the ring from a random start angle.

The task of ch2RingAWaves: once script group 0 is empty, it waits 75 frames, then sends a wave (ch2RingAWave) each 76 frames, white first and then alternating color and turn. It ends after 5 waves or 901 frames.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2, at the end of its script: makes a task (ch2RingAWavesUpdate) that sends waves of ch2RingACreate enemies.

The behaviour of ch2FlyerCreate's enemies: after 77 frames it multiplies its x speed by 0.8 each frame for 241 frames, then speeds up sideways away from x 0 by 0.01 a frame to 0.2, and ends once out of view.

Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) at z 0 that flies in (ch2FlyerMove). Its arguments: flags, y, x and x speed. Bit 0 of the flags gives its color. With bit 0x80 it has no y speed, else it moves down at 0.1.
Makes a ch2FlyerCreate enemy with the flags and y of its second and third arguments, at the x that the first picks: 0 -34, 1 34, 2 -40, 3 40, else the fourth. It flies toward x 0 at 0.1875.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a ch2FlyerCreate enemy at the record's x and y, with the x speed of record word 6 and the flags of record byte 0x38.

The task of ch2Flyers: when script group 1 is empty, it waits 16 frames, sends 12 ch2FlyerAt enemies, 6 on each side, at heights from 5 above to 14 below its start height, and ends. That height drops 0.1 a frame until then. Past its frame limit it ends without sending.
Makes a task (ch2FlyersUpdate) that sends ch2FlyerAt enemies, with a frame limit, a pattern (bit 0 the color, 0x40 both sides in it, 0x80 7.5 higher), a first side and a start height.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: starts ch2Flyers with a frame limit of 300, pattern 0x41 (all black), side 0 and start height 37.5.
Draws flickering glow sprites (spriteDraw3D) at points of a ch2LaserShipCreate enemy, sized at random. ch2LaserShipDraw calls it.
A node function of ch2LaserShipCreate's tree for type 1 (record byte 0x3F): draws model 0x30001 there, with the second texture list for a black ship (record byte 0x38 not 0).

Draws a ch2LaserShipCreate enemy: model 0x30000 of bank 3 through its node tree (enemyModelDrawEach), and while it is in view its glows (ch2LaserShipGlow) and its hit record in list 3. When the size at 0x170 is above 0, it also draws sprite 0x10608 at its first four points (0x88), turned 0x4000 apart. Only ch2LaserShipCreate writes that size, as 0.

The task of ch2LaserShipCreate's enemies. At 0 hit points it makes an explosion burst (explosionBurstFixed) and its death bullets (enemyDeathBullets), counts the kill for the chain, plays sound 0x0D and ends. Else it places its points at 0x88 by its type from record byte 0x3F (19 for type 0, 1 for type 1), turned by its angle, and runs its behaviour at 0x17C. It ends when that returns nonzero, else moves its sound to point 0 and steps its motion.
Stops a ch2LaserShipCreate enemy's sounds (effectStop, sequenceStop) and frees its node tree at the removal of its task.

Makes an enemy in list 3 with 120 hit points and model 0x30000 of bank 3 with a node tree, extra bytes of the given size at 0x184, and its type from record byte 0x3F. For type 1, a node of the tree runs ch2LaserShipNode. The caller sets its behaviour at 0x17C.
Places a ch2LaserShipOrbiter enemy on a circle about its centre, the owner's position while the owner lives (ch2LaserShipOrbiterMove): the centre plus its radius turned by its angle.

The behaviour of ch2LaserShipOrbiter's enemies: they circle their owner (ch2LaserShipOrbitPlace), white ones and black ones in opposite ways. While the owner's z is 0, they wait 128 frames, then fire 3 bullets of their color at angle 0x8000 (bulletFire) 8 frames apart, and repeat. When the owner's task ends, they fly up and end out of view.

Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) in a color that circles a ch2LaserShipCreate owner at radius 12 from an angle (ch2LaserShipOrbiterMove). Its fourth argument starts its fire counter.

The behaviour of ch2LaserShipSpawn's enemies: moves by its velocity. At its frame 101 from 0 it fires a laser of its color from its muzzle (enemyLaserFire) with sound 0x109, and at frame 160 plays sound 0x119. After frame 300 it ends the laser, fades 0x119 out, speeds up along z and ends out of view.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a ch2LaserShipCreate enemy that fires a laser (ch2LaserShipFireMove), coming in from the side by record byte 0x39, and starts flyers with it (ch2Flyers).

The behaviour of ch2LaserShipAimed's enemies: eases to its target in 128 frames, then turns toward a ship (aimAtPlayer). At its frame 97 from 0 it makes a laser of width 0.75 of its color (enemyLaserCreate) with sound 0x109, and at frame 156 plays 0x119. After frame 1700 of ch2AimedShipsUpdate it ends the laser, fades 0x119 out and leaves past x 45.

Makes a ch2LaserShipCreate enemy with an aimed laser (ch2LaserShipAimMove) and two enemies of its color that circle it half a turn apart (ch2LaserShipOrbiter). Record words 6 to 8 give its target. ch2AimedShipsUpdate makes it, with its own frame as the second argument.
Draws a ch2ThinLaserCreate enemy (model 0x20000) and, while it is in view, files its hit record in list 3.
Sets a ch2ThinLaserCreate enemy's muzzle point (0x74) from its position, its angle and the offset at 0x8C0DB6F0.

The task of ch2ThinLaserCreate's enemies. At 0 hit points it calls enemyKill, plays sound 0x115 and ends. Else it runs its behaviour at 0x80, ends when that returns nonzero, places its muzzle, moves its sound and steps its motion.
Stops a ch2ThinLaserCreate enemy's sounds (sequenceStop, effectStop) at the removal of its task.
Makes an enemy in list 3 with 20 hit points and a muzzle (ch2ThinLaserMuzzle), with extra bytes of the given size at 0x88. The caller sets its behaviour at 0x80.

The behaviour of ch2ThinLaserSpawn's enemies, by its record's frames: it starts motion 1 30 frames before its fire frame, then fires a thin laser of its color from its muzzle (enemyLaserFireThin) with sound 0x108 and plays 0x118 60 frames later. At the end frame it ends the laser, fades 0x118 out and runs the motion back. It holds its x speed, slows it, then rises and ends out of view.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a ch2ThinLaserCreate enemy with the record's x speed and its frames from record bytes 0x39 to 0x3F (ch2ThinLaserMove).
Draws a ch2Wall's model 0x60001 of bank 6, turned 0x8000 about y unless record byte 0x3A is 0.

The task of ch2Wall: while at y -70 or above, moves the wall by its x and y speed and adds its polygon to the scenery (sceneryAdd). Below the height of record word 9 it speeds up sideways by 0.001 a frame to 0.05, toward negative x for kind 0 (record byte 0x3A) and toward positive x for other kinds, and kind 0 with record byte 0x39 at 0 plays sound 0x102 once. It ends below y -70.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a wall in list 1 with a polygon that the ships hit (ch2WallUpdate, ch2WallDraw), from one of two tables by record byte 0x3A, moving with the record's velocity.

The behaviour of ch2SwayCreate's enemies: swings x about a centre by the sine of a phase that grows by its step, adds its y speed, and turns about y by its x move. It ends below y -37.5 once out of view.
Starts a ch2SwayCreate enemy (ch2SwayMove): its centre, amplitude and y speed from record words 6 to 8, its phase from record byte 0x39 and its step from byte 0x3A.
Makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) that swings from side to side as it moves (ch2SwayInit). ch2AimedShipsUpdate makes rows of them.

The task of ch2AimedShips. When script group 0 is empty it makes two ch2LaserShipAimed ships from its data, and it makes each one once more after its removal before frame 1540. After the second removal of both ships, every 71 frames before frame 1750 it makes a row of 11 ch2SwayCreate enemies with centres from x -35 to 35 in alternating colors. A first removal at frame 1540 or later prevents the rows. At frame 1851 it unlocks the stage (stageUnlock) and ends.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2, the last record of its third script (ch2Script3Start): makes a task (ch2AimedShipsUpdate) with the records of two ships and a row from a table at 0x8C0DB76C.
Draws a ch2SmallBlockCreate block: model 0x30002 at its motion's frame, turned a quarter turn about x. It files its hit record in list 3 below the height at 0x78.

The task of ch2SmallBlockCreate's blocks. At 0 hit points it marks itself, and on the next frame it calls enemyDestroyed, plays sound 6 and ends. Else it runs its behaviour at 0x74, ends when that returns nonzero, and steps its motion.

Makes a small block of chapter 2 in list 3 with 8 hit points, model 0x30002 of bank 3 and a polygon of 7 by 3 that the ships hit (ch2SceneryPolygon). It adds extra bytes of the given size at 0x80, and the caller sets its behaviour at 0x74.
A behaviour of ch2SmallBlockCreate's blocks: moves down by its y speed and ends the block below y 0 once it is out of view.
Starts ch2SmallBlockSinkMove with a y speed of -0.1.
A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a ch2SmallBlockCreate block that sinks (ch2SmallBlockSinkInit). The third script places them in groups of six.

Draws a ch2BigBlockCreate block turned by its angles: model 0x30006 of bank 3, and while it is in view model 0x30007 at -8 on the block's own y axis, with the second texture list when the block is black. All records of ch2BigBlockA and ch2BigBlockB turn that axis into the x axis. It files its hit record in list 3 below the height at 0x6C.

The task of ch2BigBlockCreate's blocks. At 0 hit points it marks itself, and on the next frame it moves 5 toward the centre in x, calls enemyKill, plays sound 6 and ends. Else it runs its behaviour at 0x70 and ends when that returns nonzero.

Makes a big block of chapter 2 in list 3 with 20 hit points, model 0x30006 of bank 3 and a polygon of 21 by 6 that the ships hit (ch2SceneryPolygon). It adds extra bytes of the given size at 0x78, and the caller sets its behaviour at 0x70.

The behaviour of ch2EmergerA's enemies: moves by its velocity and slows its x speed by 0.04 a frame down to 0.15, and ends with its block until then. After that it ends when it meets the scenery (sceneryHit), or below y 37.5 once out of view.
Makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) that comes out of a big block sideways (ch2EmergerAMove), with an x speed from record word 6, a y speed of -0.1 and the block as its owner.
The behaviour of ch2BigBlockA's blocks: moves down by its y speed, and below y 60 it lets out a ch2EmergerA enemy at its place every 90 frames. It ends the block below y 0 once it is out of view.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a ch2BigBlockCreate block that sinks at 0.1 and lets out enemies (ch2BigBlockAMove). They leave toward the side of record byte 0x39 in the block's color. Record byte 0x3A starts the block's 90-frame count, which runs from the block's start, so it shifts the frames at which enemies come out below y 60.

The behaviour of ch2EmergerB's enemies: moves by its velocity and slows its x speed by 0.04 a frame down to 0.25, and ends with its block until then. It stops 2.5 before the centre in x, turns about y to angle 0x8000 by 0x400 a frame, then moves down at 0.35 and ends once out of view.
Makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) that comes out of a big block sideways (ch2EmergerBMove), with an x speed from record word 6, a y speed of -0.1 and the block as its owner.
The behaviour of ch2BigBlockB's blocks: moves down by its y speed, and below y 40 it lets out a ch2EmergerB enemy at its place every 32 frames. It ends the block below y 0 once it is out of view.

A stage script's record function of chapter 2: makes a ch2BigBlockCreate block that sinks at 0.1 and lets out enemies (ch2BigBlockBMove). They leave toward the side of record byte 0x39 in the block's color, and record byte 0x3A sets the time to the first.
Starts chapter 2's first stage script, at 0x8C0DB92C (scriptStart). The stage program calls it in its first part.
Starts chapter 2's second stage script, at 0x8C0DCD5C (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at scroll position 19500.
Starts chapter 2's third stage script, at 0x8C0DD4C8 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at the start of its second part.
Starts chapter 2's fourth stage script, at 0x8C0E0A84 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at the start of its third part.

Sets two points of part 6 or 7 of chapter 2's boss (by its argument) from the current matrix: a random point in a box at 0xE4 plus 12 times the argument, where its fall makes explosions, and a fixed point at 0xFC plus 12 times it, where it bursts (ch2BossPart67Fall).
A node function of the tree of part 6 of chapter 2's boss: files part 6's hit record (0x2D4) in list 3, and places its points (ch2BossPoints6) once it breaks off (byte 0x94).
A node function of chapter 2's boss tree for node 5: keeps the node's matrix (0x4E8), where part 6 sits until it breaks off (ch2BossPart6Draw).

Draws part 6 of chapter 2's boss, model 0x40006 of bank 4 through its node tree at the frame at 0x150: at the matrix that its node keeps (0x4E8), moved and turned by its own place and angles while it breaks off (byte 0x94 at 1 or 2), and not once it is gone (3).
A node function of the tree of part 7 of chapter 2's boss: files part 7's hit record (0x314) in list 3, mirrored in x, and places its points (ch2BossPoints6) once it breaks off (byte 0x95).
A node function of chapter 2's boss tree for node 8: keeps the node's matrix (0x528), where part 7 sits until it breaks off (ch2BossPart7Draw).

Draws part 7 of chapter 2's boss, model 0x40007 of bank 4 through its node tree at the frame at 0x154: at the matrix that its node keeps (0x528), moved and turned by its own place and angles while it breaks off (byte 0x95 at 1 or 2), and not once it is gone (3).

Sets two points of part 4 or 5 of chapter 2's boss (by its argument) from the current matrix: a random point in a box at 0x64 plus 12 times the argument, where its fall makes explosions, and a fixed point at 0x7C plus 12 times it, where it bursts (ch2BossPart45Fall).
A node function of the tree of part 4 of chapter 2's boss: files part 4's hit record (0x254) in list 3, and places its points (ch2BossPoints4) once it breaks off (byte 0x14).
A node function of chapter 2's boss tree for node 6: keeps the node's matrix (0x468), where part 4 sits until it breaks off (ch2BossPart4Draw).

Draws part 4 of chapter 2's boss, model 0x40004 of bank 4 through its node tree at the frame at 0x148: at the matrix that its node keeps (0x468), moved and turned by its own place and angles while it breaks off (byte 0x14 at 1 or 2), and not once it is gone (3).
A node function of the tree of part 5 of chapter 2's boss: files part 5's hit record (0x294) in list 3, mirrored in x, and places its points (ch2BossPoints4) once it breaks off (byte 0x15).
A node function of chapter 2's boss tree for node 7: keeps the node's matrix (0x4A8), where part 5 sits until it breaks off (ch2BossPart5Draw).

Draws part 5 of chapter 2's boss, model 0x40005 of bank 4 through its node tree at the frame at 0x14C: at the matrix that its node keeps (0x4A8), moved and turned by its own place and angles while it breaks off (byte 0x15 at 1 or 2), and not once it is gone (3).
The node function that ch2BossUpdate gives node 3 of chapter 2's boss tree when the white core is destroyed: keeps the node's matrix (0x3E8), where ch2BossDraw draws the broken core, model 0x40008.
The node function that ch2BossUpdate gives node 4 of chapter 2's boss tree when the black core is destroyed: keeps the node's matrix (0x428), where ch2BossDraw draws the broken core, model 0x40009.
A node function of chapter 2's boss tree for node 1: scales its part to 0 in z.
A node function of chapter 2's boss tree for node 2: scales its part to 0 in z.
A node function of chapter 2's boss tree for node 0: keeps the node's matrix (0x3A8), where ch2BossDraw draws model 0x40001.

Draws the glow of one core of chapter 2's boss (0 white, 1 black) while the core lives and its cover is out (0x164 or 0x168 by side, above 0): sprite 0x10A02, which changes size at random, and a pulsing sprite 0x10901 at a place from the table at 0x8C0E0AD0. Their base size is a quarter of how far the cover is out, or 1.125 beyond 4. The flags go by the side.

Draws chapter 2's boss (ch2BossCreate): its body, model 0x40000 through its node tree at its motion's frame, and keeps its matrix (0x368). While a core is hit, it turns on a point light near it (lightOn). It files the cores' hit records in list 3 while their covers are out (bytes 2 and 3) and the fight lasts (byte 0xE clear), and always the body's. Then it draws the cores' glows (ch2BossCoreGlow), model 0x40001, the broken cores (models 0x40008 and 0x40009, bytes 4 and 5) and its four parts (ch2BossPart4Draw to ch2BossPart7Draw).

Places the 24 fire points of each side of chapter 2's boss (0x568 and 0x688) from the table at 0x8C0E0AF4, mirrored in x for the second side, at the boss's x and y and turned by its angle at 0x130. All but the first get a fixed z.

Fires a turning bullet (bulletSpinFireAt) in the color of a core of chapter 2's boss from the next of fire points 2 to 7 on its side, at angle 0x9800 or 0x6800 by the side within 0x1000 at random, with an effect sprite (effectFollowScaled).

Fires a sprite bullet (bulletSpriteFireAt10508) in the color of a core of chapter 2's boss from fire point 8 plus its argument on its side, at angle 0xB000 or 0x5000 by the side, with an effect sprite (effectFollowScaled).
Draws a ch2BossVolley's charge while it charges: glow sprite 0x10A02 at a random size at its fire point, with flags by its side.

The task of ch2BossVolley: charges for 65 frames, then fires 5 bullets 4 frames apart from its fire point (ch2BossSpriteFire), each slower than the one before (speed 0.5 down to 0.34), and ends. It ends early when the boss's task ends or the bullets vanish (stageEvents 0x02).
Makes a task in list 4 (ch2BossVolleyUpdate, ch2BossVolleyDraw) for one fire point of chapter 2's boss: a side, and a point from 0 to 15 that stands for fire point 8 to 23 of that side.

Makes 7 black drifting pieces (effectDriftCreate) at the point of the table at 0x8C0E0BB4 for the side, moved by the boss's x and y. They fly to the two sides in turn and down at 0.225 to 0.975 by their order, each with a random part. ch2BossUpdate makes them when a core is destroyed.

The fall of part 4 or 5 of chapter 2's boss (by its argument) after the boss is destroyed: it moves out to its side, falls and turns each frame, with an explosion (effectExplosion) at a random point on it every other frame. After 91 to 154 frames, at random, it bursts (explosionBurst) with sound 0x117 and is gone.

The fall of part 6 or 7 of chapter 2's boss (by its argument) after the boss is destroyed: it moves out to its side, falls and turns each frame, with an explosion (effectExplosion) at a random point on it every other frame. After 91 to 154 frames, at random, it bursts (explosionBurst) with sound 0x116 and is gone.

The entry of chapter 2's boss, which ch2BossUpdate runs until it returns 1. With sound 0x105 it loops motion 2 of the body and moves the boss in at z -30 from x -72.5 and y -30 to x 0 and y 17.5 in 256 frames while it rolls. Then it starts the music (sequencePlay 4), waits 17 frames and moves the boss to y 18 and z -4 in 128 frames.

The task of chapter 2's boss (ch2BossCreate), in 26 steps. It comes in (ch2BossEnter), shows its signs (ch2BossSign) and makes a boss timer of 100 seconds (bossTimerCreate). 60 frames later the fight starts (byte 0x114): the timer runs and the covers drop (ch2BossCoverUpdate). After about 512 frames it attacks in a cycle, with waits between: a motion, turning four-way sprite bullets for 256 frames, 64 frames from each side in turn, turning bullets from the sides in turn (ch2BossSpinFire) for 512 frames, the motion backward, a move down, volleys (ch2BossVolley) for 513 frames and a move back up. It sways in x, but not during the volleys. Until the second cycle ends, it fires aimed bullets from the sides in turn every 8 to 24 frames by its difficulty value (byte 0xF), which grows when a ship is lost, and a core at 0 hit points explodes (ch2BossDebris) and the bullets vanish. With both cores destroyed it plays sound 0x104, stops the ships' shots, sets the boss state (bossStateSet 1), breaks off its four parts at frames 30 to 210 (ch2BossPart45Fall, ch2BossPart67Fall) while it explodes and turns, and makes its destruction (bossDeathCreate) at frame 180. Else, after two cycles and the timer's end, it stops the ships' shots, rises until y passes 120, lowers the stage's lock (stageUnlock) and ends.
Frees the five node trees of chapter 2's boss when its task ends.

Makes chapter 2's boss in list 3 (ch2BossUpdate, ch2BossDraw): model 0x40000 of bank 4 with a node tree and its node functions, an armoured body (hit flag 0x02), a white and a black core of 600 hit points each (900 in a game with two players, hitInitRegistered), and four armoured parts with their own trees, models 0x40004 to 0x40007, of which 4 and 6 are white. It makes the cores' covers (ch2BossCoverCreate) and sets its difficulty value (byte 0xF) to 4 on easy, 2 on normal and 0 on hard. Chapter 2's stage program calls it.
Draws a ch2BossCoverCreate cover at the boss's matrix, moved out by its distance: files its hit record in list 3 and draws its model, turned by its angles once it flies off.

The task of a ch2BossCoverCreate cover. Once the fight starts (boss byte 0x114), it falls from 19.5 to 0 with bounces, with sound 0x106 for the white side. Then every other frame a hit by a shot of its own color pushes it out by 0.7 and a step, up to 19.5, and it sinks back by that step each frame, 0.06 to 0.02 by the boss's difficulty value. While it is out more than 2, the core of its side can be hit. Hits no longer push it once the fight ends (boss byte 0xE). When its core is destroyed, it flies off turning and ends once out of view.

Makes the cover of one core of chapter 2's boss in list 3 (ch2BossCoverUpdate, ch2BossCoverDraw): model 0x40002, white, at x -6.15 for side 0, or model 0x40003, black, at x 6.15 for side 1, armoured (hit flag 0x02) with 800 hit points, out by 19.5 at the start.
Draws a ch2BossSign: sprite 0x11700 at its size and alpha, and sprites 0x11603 and 0x11604 for side 0 or 0x11605 and 0x11606 for side 1.
The task of ch2BossSign: fades in by 0x11 a frame, holds for about 60 frames, fades out and ends, while its size shrinks from 2 to 1 by 0.05 a frame.
Makes a task in list 4 (ch2BossSignUpdate, ch2BossSignDraw) at a position, for a side. ch2BossUpdate makes one at x -6 and one at x 6 when its entry ends, 60 frames before the fight starts.

Draws chapter 2's first background: a grid of 5 by 5 tiles 500 apart around the camera, model 0x40000 of bank 4 (S02_BG00), or 0x40001 at some places and scroll positions, and model 0x50003 of bank 5 at one place. It also draws model 0x40002 at the camera, turned and scaled to 0.225. All draws use the fog flag.
The task of ch2Bg00Create's background: ends once the scroll passes 18000.
Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 2's first background (ch2Bg00Update, ch2Bg00Draw). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at its start, through ch2Bg00CreateJump.
Jumps to ch2Bg00Create (a stub of mov.l and jmp). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at its start.

Draws chapter 2's shaft of bank 5 (S02_BG00B) at x -5250, z -6750 with the fog flag: 4 levels 400 apart down in y, the top one with model 0x50002 and the others with model 0x50004 once the scroll passes their positions. Each level has models 0x50000 and 0x50001, moved apart in x by its offset.

The task of ch2Bg00bCreate's shaft: plays sound 0x100 once the scroll passes 17750. As the scroll passes 17750, 18250, 18750 and 19250, it moves the two models of each level apart, at a speed that grows by 0.05 a frame up to 1. It ends once the scroll passes 19600.
Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 2's shaft (ch2Bg00bUpdate, ch2Bg00bDraw). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 14250, through ch2Bg00bCreateJump.
Jumps to ch2Bg00bCreate (a stub of mov.l and jmp). Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 14250.
Draws chapter 2's background of bank 6 (S02_BG01) with the fog flag: model 0x60000 3 times, 800 apart in z from x -5250, y -1600 and a z by its offset, and once more before scroll position 19550.
The task of ch2Bg01Create's background: once the scroll passes 19600 its speed grows by 0.0025 a frame up to 0.25. It moves its offset by that speed, wrapped at 800.

Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 2's background of bank 6 (ch2Bg01Update, ch2Bg01Draw), with its offset at 150. Chapter 2's stage program calls it after ch2BankFree4, through ch2Bg01CreateJump.
Jumps to ch2Bg01Create (a stub of mov.l and jmp). Chapter 2's stage program calls it.
Returns the camera value at 0x8C1D1508 for a phase from 0 to 1 of ch2ShipsSequence: from -16384 at 0 to -65000 at 1.
Moves one ship of ch2ShipsSequence from its start to its target place and angles by the cosine of the sequence's phase (pointBlendCos).
Moves both ships of ch2ShipsSequence (ch2ShipsBlendOne), or puts them at their targets and returns 1 once the phase reaches 0x8000.

The draw of ch2ShipsSequence after its first step: each ship that takes part at the sequence's place for it on the path, turned about z by the third of its angles (0x98 or 0xA4). It keeps that matrix for its side effects and draws the ship's model (shipModelDraw) while the ship's state is below 3 and forced flag 0x04 is set.
Makes a shock ring (shockRingCreate, 31 segments) at a ship of ch2ShipsSequence, with a texture by its argument.
Makes a second kind of shock ring (shockRingCreate, 31 segments) at a ship of ch2ShipsSequence, with a texture by its argument.

Ends ch2ShipsSequence for one ship: when it takes part, puts the ship at its place with speed 0.5 and a turn effect (playerTurnEffect). Then it clears the ship's forced flags and input (playerClearInput) and sets its hp to 1.

A step of ch2ShipsSequence for one ship: at frames by its order it moves its side effects on (byte 0x27), makes a shock ring in the ship's polarity (ch2ShipsRing1), and 24 frames later a second one (ch2ShipsRing2). Then it ends the first, moves the side effects on again and plays sound 0x10C.
Sets the first move of one ship of ch2ShipsSequence that takes part: from its place and angles to a place from the table at 0x8C0E1074 by its order, turned a full turn about z one way or the other.

A step of ch2ShipsSequence for one ship that takes part: slows the ship down to speed 0 by 0.025 a frame and keeps its position as the start of its move. At frame 80 or 135 by its order it makes its two side effects (shipSideEffectCreate).
Sets the next move of one ship of ch2ShipsSequence that takes part: from where its last move ended to x -6.25 for ship 0 or 6.25 for ship 1, at y and z 0 and angles 0.

The task of ch2ShipsSequence, in steps for the ships (ch2ShipsStart, ch2ShipsSlow, ch2ShipsRings, ch2ShipsTargetSet and ch2ShipsBlend) and for the camera. At frame 32 it puts the camera on the path (mode 0) and starts the ships' first move. The camera's phase moves the camera value at 0x8C1D1508 (ch2ShipsCameraAngle), and it eases the values at 0x8C1D1510 and 0x8C1D1514. It also sets the scroll's target to 8, and at frame 580 stops the scroll at about 19675 (scrollStopAt). When the ships' moves and the camera's ease have ended, it puts the camera in mode 1, releases the ships (ch2ShipsRelease), lets players join again, lowers the stage's lock (stageUnlock) and ends.

Makes a task in list 2 that takes both ships through a sequence (ch2ShipsSequenceUpdate, ch2ShipsDraw), with the player of the higher score first in a game with two players. It sets the ships' forced flags 0x02, 0x08 and 0x20, clears their shot, switch and release input, stops joining and sets stageEvents 0x0A. Chapter 2's stage program calls it at scroll position 14500.
Loads bank 8 under the name S03_BG00 from the file list at 0x8C0E6CD0, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 9 under the name S03_BG01 from the file list at 0x8C0E6D90, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 10 under the name S03_BG02 from the file list at 0x8C0E6EE8, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 2 under the name S03_OBJ00 from the file list at 0x8C0E6C0C, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 3 under the name S03_OBJ01 from the file list at 0x8C0E6C4C, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 4 under the name S03_BOSS from the file list at 0x8C0E6F5C, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 8 (S03_BG00) at once and banks 9 (S03_BG01), 3 (S03_OBJ01) and 2 (S03_OBJ00) over frames. Chapter 3's stage program calls it at its start.
Frees bank 8 (bankFree). Chapter 3's stage program calls it at scroll position 1061.
Loads banks 9 (S03_BG01), 3 (S03_OBJ01) and 2 (S03_OBJ00) at once and banks 10 (S03_BG02) and 4 (S03_BOSS) over frames. Chapter 3's stage program calls it at the start of its second part.
Loads banks 10 (S03_BG02) and 4 (S03_BOSS) at once. Chapter 3's stage program calls it at the start of its third part.
Frees banks 2 and 3 (bankFree). Chapter 3's stage program calls it at the start of its third part.
Frees bank 9 (bankFree). Chapter 3's stage program calls it in its third part at scroll position 500.

Sets chapter 3's light (its two angles, color, intensity and ambient, and for the multi-light models the color of light 1 and three more values), and the fog's color to 100, 125, 155, its depths (fogTableSet) and the fade's level 0.5, with byte 4 of ninjaFadeLevel at 0, and sets fogFadeOn. Chapter 3's stage program calls it at its start.
Fades the fog to color 160, 100, 80 with depths -80 and -220 in 360 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 3's stage program calls it.
Fades the fog to color 80, 120, 160 with depths -80 and -600 in 360 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 3's stage program calls it at the start of its third part.
Fades the multi-light models' light 1 to color 1, 0.7, 0.5 and their three more values to 0.4, 0.44, 0.5 in 300 frames (lightsFadeTo). Chapter 3's stage program calls it.
Fades the fog to color 80, 120, 160 with depths -80 and -220 in 360 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 3's stage program calls it in its third part.

Fades the main light to angles 0xA000 and 0x2000, the multi-light models' light 1 to color 1, 0.64, 0.4 and their three more values to 0.4, 0.5, 0.56, in 300 frames (lightsFadeTo). Chapter 3's stage program calls it in its third part at scroll position 400.
Starts chapter 3's music (sequencePlay 5) and plays sound 0x10B. Chapter 3's stage program calls it at its start.
Fades the music of sequence slot 0 out (sequenceSetVolume to -127 over 10000). Chapter 3's stage program calls it.
Shows the left band with bank 8's sprites 0x80000 to 0x80003 (leftBandCreate). Chapter 3's stage program calls it at scroll position 550.
Plays sound 0x3A (soundPlay). Chapter 3's stage program calls it.
Ends an enemy of chapter 3 that meets the scenery: when its position lies in the scenery (sceneryHit), it explodes (enemyExplosion) with sound 0x102 and the function returns 1.
A behaviour of chapter 3's enemies: moves down by its y speed and ends below y 0 once out of view.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) that moves down 0.125 a frame faster than the lanes (ch3SinkMove).

The task of chapter 3's mid-boss (ch3MidBossCreate). After 918 frames it comes in, following the ship in x until frame 1392, then toward x 0. At frame 1567 it moves to y 22.5 with sound 0x102, then opens, makes 4 pods that circle it (ch3MidBossPodCreate) with sound 0x101, and drops its armour (hit flags 0x82) after its opening motion. Every 152 frames it makes a gate with a gap at its x (ch3GateAt), 14 times while it lives, and between gates it moves to x 10 or -10 at random and back to 0. Then it is armoured again and, if it lives, rises to y 150 with sound 0x102. Then it lowers the stage's lock (stageUnlock) and ends. From 450, 300 or 60 frames (easy, normal, hard) after the pods appear, it fires at a ship in rounds of 3 white and 3 black shots, only the first of each color while 3 or more pods live, at a rate and speed by the pods left. Every 80 frames it makes pillars (ch3PillarsAt). Its halves die at 0 hit points (enemyKill, sound 0x0D). With both halves and all pods dead it bursts 61 frames later (explosionBurst, ch3Splitters, sound 0x104).
A node function of the tree of chapter 3's mid-boss that does nothing.
A node function of the tree of chapter 3's mid-boss: turns its part about y to the boss's aim (0x70) less half a turn.

Draws chapter 3's mid-boss until it bursts: model 0x30000 of bank 3 through its node tree at its motion's frame, turned by its x angle and half a turn about y, and files the hit records of its white and black halves in list 3. While a half is hit and not armoured, it turns on a point light near it (lightOn).
Clears the mid-boss pointer at 0x8C1EA4C8 and frees the mid-boss's node tree when its task ends.

Makes chapter 3's mid-boss in list 3 (ch3MidBossUpdate, ch3MidBossDraw) at y -70: model 0x30000 of bank 3 with a node tree, aimed at a ship, with a white and a black half of 400 hit points each (hitInitRegistered), armoured and not a target for homing lasers at the start (hit flags 0x82). Its pod count is 4, and it keeps itself at 0x8C1EA4C8.
Places a pod of chapter 3's mid-boss on its circle: at the boss's position plus the boss's radius (0x20) in the direction of the boss's turn angle (0x18) plus a quarter turn for each pod index.

Draws a ch3MidBossPodCreate pod: its model turned by its angle, and its hit record in list 3 while in view. While the boss fires its beams (byte 0x11), it also draws a flickering sprite of 0x1070C to 0x1070F at its place in its color.

The task of a pod of chapter 3's mid-boss, which ends with the boss's task. At 0 hit points it lowers the boss's pod count, pauses the boss's fire for 60 frames, raises the boss's turn speed by a value per difficulty, calls enemyKill, plays sound 0x103 and ends. Else it keeps its place on the circle (ch3MidBossPodPlace). While the boss's byte 0x11 is set, it fires a shock ring once (shockRingFire) and every 4 frames two linked bullets down in its color (linkBulletCreate), each chained to the last of its line.

Makes a pod of chapter 3's mid-boss in list 3 (ch3MidBossPodUpdate, ch3MidBossPodDraw) with 240 hit points (hitInitRegistered), white with model 0x30001 or black with model 0x30002 by its color argument, at a quarter turn per index around the boss (ch3MidBossPodPlace).

The behaviour of ch3DropperCreate's enemies: moves for 21 frames at its start speed and stops. It stands still for its wait plus 3 frames, then falls faster by its step up to its limit. It ends when it meets the scenery, where it explodes with sound 0x102, and after its first step also once out of view.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) that moves down at 0.5, stops, waits and falls (ch3DropperMove), with its wait, speed limit and step from the arguments.
Makes a ch3DropperCreate enemy with no wait, which then falls faster by 0.05 a frame up to 1.25.

The task of ch3DropperStream: every 13 frames it makes a ch3DropperFast enemy at its x, three white, then three black. In 19 of each 24 it moves its x by 6.75, back and forth within 20.25 of the centre, and at random turns back. Once its owner's task has ended, it ends after a multiple of 3 enemies.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch3DropperStreamUpdate) that sends ch3DropperFast enemies from y 40, with an owner whose end ends it.
The task of ch3DropperWait: waits until script group 1 has members and then is empty, and 30 frames later starts a ch3DropperStream that it owns. It ends at frame 1151, which also ends the stream.
A stage script's record function of chapter 3's second script: makes a task (ch3DropperWaitUpdate) that starts a stream of falling enemies once script group 1 is cleared.

The behaviour of ch3SwerverCreate's enemies: moves down until it is below the ship's y (targetPlayerIndex), stops and turns toward the ship's side in 8 frames, speeds up sideways for 20 frames and goes on. From its sideways move on, it ends once out of view, or when it meets the scenery, where it explodes with sound 0x102.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) with the record's velocity that drops and swerves toward a ship (ch3SwerverMove).

The task of ch3SwerverPairs: every 17 frames, in 3 of each 7 steps, it makes a mirrored pair of ch3SwerverCreate enemies at x 20 and -20, and it switches their color after each 7 steps. It ends after 21 pairs.
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes a task in list 3 (ch3SwerverPairsUpdate) that sends pairs of swerving enemies from y 40 with y speed -0.5.

The task of a lane of chapter 3 (ch3LaneStart): it steps through a list of records of 0x4C bytes while its distances grow by the lane speed (ch3LaneSpeed) each frame. When a distance reaches a record's interval (word 1), it calls the record's function (word 2) with the record's data, its y moved back by the overshoot. A record repeats by the count in byte 1, then the next one follows. Byte 0 bit 0 counts from the lane's start, and bit 0x80 ends the lane.
Makes a task in list 0 that runs a lane of chapter 3 (ch3LaneUpdate) from a list of records, with an index.

Draws a ch3GateCreate gate: the model of its kind (0x90004 for kind 1, 0x90003 for kind 2, 0x90005 for kind 3) at x 0 and 20 above its y, turned a quarter turn about x. Kind 0, the kind of the lane gates, draws nothing.
The task of a ch3GateCreate gate: moves its two walls down by the lane speed (ch3LaneSpeed), adds their polygons to the scenery (sceneryAdd), and ends below y -80.

Makes a gate in list 1 with the given update and ch3GateDraw as its draw: two walls 60 wide and 40 high (polygonInit), the left one ending at x record word 6 and the right one starting at x record word 7, at the record's y, with the gap between them. Its kind (record byte 0x38) picks its model.
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes a gate (ch3GateCreate) that moves with the lanes (ch3GateMove).
The task of a ch3GateUntil gate: ch3GateMove until the scroll passes 420, then it ends.
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes a gate (ch3GateCreate) that ends once the scroll passes 420 (ch3GateMoveUntil).
