Makes a gate (ch3Gate) of a kind at a position, with its gap from one x to another. While the mid-boss lives, ch3MidBossUpdate makes one at y 40 after each of its moves but the first and the last.
The task of ch3Wall: moves its polygon down by the lane speed and adds it to the scenery (sceneryAdd) while the polygon's top lies above y -40. It ends below y -80 or once the scroll passes 420.
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes a task in list 1 (ch3WallUpdate) with one polygon, one of six shapes by record byte 0x38, at x 0 and the record's y.
Draws a ch3PillarsCreate object: the model of its kind at its position, turned a quarter turn about x, with the fog flag.
The task of ch3PillarsCreate: moves its model and its two polygons down by the lane speed, adds the polygons to the scenery (sceneryAdd) when it has them, and ends below y -142.5.

Makes a task in list 1 (ch3PillarsUpdate, ch3PillarsDraw) for an object of chapter 3 by record byte 0x38: kinds 0 to 5 draw models 0x90000, 0x90001, 0x90002, 0x90006, 0x90007 and 0x90008 of bank 9, 40 above the record's y. Kinds 0, 1, 2 and 4 also have two polygons that the ships hit, at x -12.5 and 12.5 for kind 4, else at -26 and 26.
Makes a ch3PillarsCreate object of a kind at a height. ch3MidBossUpdate makes kind 2 at y 80 every 80 frames.
The behaviour of ch3BlockEnemyCreate's enemies: moves by its velocity until it meets the scenery (ch3SceneryCrash), and ends below y 0 once out of view.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) with the record's x speed, and its y speed plus the lane speed (ch3BlockEnemyMove).
Places an enemy of a ch3Ring about the ring's centre: in the direction of the ring's angle (data word 3) at 7.5 times the absolute cosine of its phase (word 4), and sets its velocity from the move.

The behaviour of ch3Ring's enemies: moves the ring's centre down by the lane speed, turns the ring by 0x1C0 and the phase by 0x80 a frame, and places the enemy (ch3RingPlace). Homing lasers can aim at it once the centre is below y 40. It ends when it meets the scenery (ch3SceneryCrash), or below y -47.5 once out of view.

A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes 6 enemies with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) on a ring that turns and pulses (ch3RingMove), a sixth of a turn apart from record word 4 with record byte 0x39, else from a random angle. They alternate in color from record byte 0x38 and in phase by a quarter turn, so the two sets of 3 pulse in turn. On easy, record byte 0x3F skips it.
Places an enemy of a ch3Grid at its offset from the grid's centre, scaled between 0.75 and 1.75 by the sine of its phase (data word 8), and sets its velocity from the move.

The behaviour of ch3Grid's enemies: moves the grid's centre down by the lane speed and the phase by 0x200 a frame (ch3GridPlace). Below the height of record word 6 the centre moves from its depth to z 0 in 128 frames. Then the enemy ends once out of view, or when it meets the scenery (ch3SceneryCrash).
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes 9 enemies with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) in a grid of 3 by 3, 5 apart, that pulses as it moves down (ch3GridMove).
Places a ch3UTurn enemy: x at its centre plus its amplitude times the cosine of its phase, y at its centre plus its distance so far. It faces along its move.

The behaviour of ch3UTurn's enemies: moves with the lanes and by its y speed until its distance passes the record's limit (word 8). Then in 64 frames its y speed turns back while it swings across, half a turn of its phase, and it ends once out of view.

A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) that moves by its y speed, up in the lanes' records, and turns back while it swings across (ch3UTurnMove), with its amplitude, y speed and limit from record words 6 to 8.

A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes 18 ch3BlockEnemyCreate enemies in 6 columns 6.75 apart about the record's x and 3 rows 8 apart up from its y. On normal and hard their colors make a checkered pattern. On easy the left three columns have one color and the right three the other, and the two swap from row to row.
The task of ch3LaserFrameWatch: each frame it marks each of its frame's four emitters free while the emitter's check point lies outside the scenery (sceneryHit). It ends with its frame.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch3LaserFrameWatchUpdate) for a ch3LaserFrame.
Gives a ch3LaserFrame its path, a table of points with a count, and fills in each point's length to the next and its distance from the start, measured as the sum of the x and y differences.
Places the four emitters of a ch3LaserFrame a quarter turn apart about its centre, turned by its angle: each with a laser start point, a check point (ch3LaserFrameWatch) and the laser's angle.

Moves a ch3LaserFrame along its path by its speed. At each new point it stops there, sets its speed to 0 and holds its speed-up for 15 frames. It places the frame between two points by its distance, from the frame's base position.
Draws a ch3LaserFrame: model 0x80003 of bank 8 at its position, turned a quarter turn about x, and keeps whether it is out of view.
The task of ch3LaserFrameSound: after its frames it stops its frame's sound and plays sound 0x100 at the frame. It ends with its frame.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch3LaserFrameSoundUpdate) that plays a ch3LaserFrame's sound after a number of frames.

The task of ch3LaserFrame. It runs its kind's behaviour at 0xA8 and ends when that returns nonzero, with its sound faded out. Else it moves down with the lanes, speeds up by 0.01 a frame to its top speed along its path (ch3LaserFrameFollow) and places its emitters. An emitter that is on and free fires a laser (enemyLaserCreate), white for emitters 0 and 2 and black for 1 and 3, with the sound 5 frames later (ch3LaserFrameSound). Otherwise the emitter ends its laser. The sound fades out when no laser is on. It adds its polygon to the scenery while its y lies between -50 and 50.
The behaviour of a ch3LaserFrame of kind 0: speed and top speed 0.1 from its first frame, all lasers on past distance 10 and off past 50. After that it ends once out of view.
The behaviour of a ch3LaserFrame of kind 1: speed and top speed 0.125 from its first frame, all lasers on past distance 40 and off past 140. After that it ends once out of view.

The behaviour of a ch3LaserFrame of kind 2: stays at its path's start for 252 frames, then sets its speed and top speed to 0.15. All lasers are on past distance 50, emitter 2 is off past 90, on past 120 and off past 190. After that it ends once out of view.

The behaviour of a ch3LaserFrame of kind 3: stays at its path's start for 14 frames, then sets its speed and top speed to 0.15. All lasers are on past distance 37.5, emitter 2 is off past 77.5, and all are off from 197.5. After that it ends once out of view.

A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes a laser frame in list 1 (ch3LaserFrameUpdate, ch3LaserFrameDraw) at the record's position and angles, with a polygon of 8 corners that the ships hit and four laser emitters (ch3LaserFrameEmitters, ch3LaserFrameWatch). Record byte 0x38 picks its kind: its behaviour (ch3LaserFrameKind0 to ch3LaserFrameKind3) and its path from one of four tables (ch3LaserFramePath).
Draws a ch3Turret: model 0x9000A of bank 9 at its position, turned a quarter turn about x and by its angle about y, and files its hit record in list 3 while in view.

The task of a ch3Turret: moves down with the lanes and places its muzzle and its check point by its angle. At 0 hit points it calls enemyDestroyed, plays sound 6 and ends. When its check point meets the scenery it explodes with sound 0x102 and ends. Else, every 16 frames until a ship is lost (stageEvents 0x04), it fires a turning bullet of its color from its muzzle along its angle (bulletSpinCreate) with an effect sprite. It ends below y -40 once out of view.
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes a turret in list 3 (ch3TurretUpdate, ch3TurretDraw) with 10 hit points (enemyInit). On easy, record byte 0x3F skips it.
Draws a ch3LaserTurret: model 0x9000A of bank 9 at its position, turned a quarter turn about x and by its angle about y, and files its hit record in list 3 while in view.

The task of a ch3LaserTurret: moves down with the lanes and places its muzzle by its angle. Below the height of record word 6 it fires a laser of its color along its angle (enemyLaserCreate), and with record byte 0x39 it plays sound 0x107 15 frames later. It ends below y 0 once out of view.
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes an armoured laser turret in list 3 (ch3LaserTurretUpdate, ch3LaserTurretDraw) with 10 hit points that homing lasers do not aim at (enemyInitUnaimed).

The behaviour of ch3Riser's enemies: moves down with the lanes for 82 frames, then its y speed grows by 0.02 a frame until it moves up. After 76 more frames it speeds up by 0.0125 a frame and ends once out of view.

A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) that moves down with the lanes, then slows to a stop and rises (ch3RiserMove), with explosion kind 0x42 (flag 0x04 of byte 0x69).

The behaviour of ch3Swinger's enemies: waits its frames, then swings across in x by the cosine of a phase whose step grows to 0x200, while its y speed grows by 0.0175 a frame. After the wait it ends once out of view.

Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) that moves down at the lane speed for its wait, then swings across in 72 frames while its fall slows and turns into a rise (ch3SwingerMove): its wait from record bytes 0x39 and 0x3A, its amplitude and centre from record words 6 and 7.
Draws a block of a ch3BlockRow: model 0x90009 of bank 9 at its row's motion frame, turned a quarter turn about x, and keeps whether it is out of view.

The task of a block of a ch3BlockRow, which ends with its row: it keeps its place in the row and adds its polygon to the scenery (sceneryAdd) while in view. When chapter 3's mid-boss comes within 9.5 of it, it explodes with sound 0x104, raises the mid-boss's byte 0x0C and ends.
Makes a block of a ch3BlockRow in list 1 (ch3RowBlockUpdate, ch3RowBlockDraw) at an x offset in the row, with a polygon of 8 by 2.5 that the ships hit.

Motion 1 of a ch3BlockRow: once the row is below the height of record word 6, it plays sound 0x100 (record byte 0x3C), sets the blocks' motion speed to 8 and slides the row to x record word 7 by a sine ease whose phase grows by half of record word 8 a frame. On the way it fades sequence slot 4 out (record byte 0x3D) and plays sound 0x101 (record byte 0x3B). Then the blocks' motion slows by 0.125 a frame to a stop.
Motion 2 of a ch3BlockRow: once the row is below the height of record word 6, it slides the row to x record word 7 by a cosine ease, then to x record word 9.
Motion 3 of a ch3BlockRow: swings the row between its start x and x record word 7 by the sine of a phase that starts at record word 6 and grows by record word 8.

The task of a ch3BlockRow: runs its motion by record byte 0x3A (ch3BlockRowSlide, ch3BlockRowSlideTwice, ch3BlockRowSwing, or none), moves down with the lanes and steps the blocks' motion. It ends below y -40, which also ends its blocks.
Makes a task in list 1 (ch3BlockRowUpdate) for a row of 5 blocks of chapter 3 (ch3RowBlock), 8 apart going left or right by record byte 0x39, with its motion and sounds from the record.

Makes two ch3BlockRow rows at y 50 that slide (ch3BlockRowSlide) to leave a gap of the given half width about a ch3MidBossWaves task's x, one reaching left and one right. With its third argument they come in from x -25 and 25 at once, in about as many frames as the task's float at 0x08, else they open from the task's x below y 32.5 in 31 frames. The left row plays sound 0x100 by argument 4, fades sequence slot 4 by argument 5, and plays sound 0x101 at a half width of 0.

Moves the x of a ch3MidBossWaves task's gap by 6.75 each call, left while byte 0x14 is 0, else right. Past -11.5 or 11.5 it sets the x to -4.75 or 4.75, turns and clears the rows since a turn (byte 0x16).

The task that ch3MidBossStart makes beside chapter 3's mid-boss, in 8 steps by its frame count: it sends rows of blocks (ch3BlockRow, ch3BlockRowPair) whose gap moves (ch3MidBossWavesSway), sinking enemies (ch3Sinker), falling enemies (ch3DropperCreate) and crossing enemies (ch3Crosser), some by difficulty. At its end it makes 6 swinging enemies (ch3Swinger) and ends.
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes a task (ch3MidBossWavesUpdate) with random sides, and chapter 3's mid-boss (ch3MidBossCreate).
The behaviour of ch3Crosser's enemies: moves by its velocity and ends below y 0 once out of view.

Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) that crosses with the lanes at x speed record word 7, to the right with record byte 0x39 or else to the left (ch3CrosserMove). It starts back by its x speed times record word 6, so that it passes the record's x after that many frames.
A stage script's record function of chapter 3's second script: sets the lane speed (ch3LaneSpeed) to -1 and starts two lanes (ch3LaneStart) with the records at 0x8C0E205C and 0x8C0E2990.

A stage script's record function of chapter 3's first script: sets the lane speed (ch3LaneSpeed) to -0.1 and starts four lanes (ch3LaneStart) with the records at 0x8C0E49A0, 0x8C0E4B1C, 0x8C0E4D7C and 0x8C0E4EAC.
Draws chapter 3's background of bank 9 (S03_BG01) with the fog flag: models 0x90000 and 0x90001 in turn, 3 of each, 80 apart in -z from y 115 and z -700.
The task of ch3Bg01Create's background: ends once the scroll reaches 1300.
Draws chapter 3's first background of bank 8 (S03_BG00) with the fog flag: model 0x80000, model 0x80001 at z -400 and model 0x80002 at y 115 and z -620.
The task of ch3Bg00Create's background: ends once the scroll reaches 900.
Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 3's first background (ch3Bg00Update, ch3Bg00Draw). Chapter 3's stage program calls it at its start.
Makes a task in list 0 that draws chapter 3's background of bank 9 (ch3Bg01Update, ch3Bg01Draw). Chapter 3's stage program calls it.

The behaviour of a ch3ColumnEnemy: moves by its velocity and keeps its column's furthest height in its direction. When it passes the column's limit, where an enemy from the other end meets it, or meets the scenery, it explodes (enemyExplosion) with sound 0x102 and ends. After it crosses y 0 it ends once out of view. It ends with its ch3Columns task.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) for a ch3Columns task: its y speed from record word 6 and its column from record byte 0x39 (ch3ColumnEnemyMove).
The draw of ch3Columns. It does nothing.

The task of ch3Columns: until frame 832 it sends an enemy into each of 5 columns (ch3ColumnEnemy) every 32 frames, or 49 on easy, three from one end and two from the other, the ends switching each time. Those from y -42.5 are black and rise, and those from y 42.5 are white and fall, at 0.25 a frame. Each frame it sets each column's limits from where the enemies of the two ends got, so that they explode where they meet. It ends 401 frames after frame 832.
A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes a task in list 3 (ch3ColumnsUpdate, ch3ColumnsDraw) that sends enemies into 5 columns from both ends.

Draws a ch3GunshipCreate enemy: model 0x20000 of bank 2 at the frame of its motion (byte 0x6A), turned a quarter turn about x and by its angles, and files its hit record in list 3 while in view. It keeps the matrices of its two charge points and draws a glow sprite 0x10A02 at each while its size there is above 0.

The task of a ch3GunshipCreate enemy. At 0 hit points it calls enemyKill, plays sound 0x0D and ends. Else it runs its behaviour at 0x134, ends when that returns nonzero, and places its four muzzles. With its attack byte (0x74) at 1 it opens through motions 1 and 2, then fires sprite bullets of its color every other frame from two muzzles in turn (bulletSpriteFireAt10504, effectFlash). At 2 it goes through motions 3 and 4, charges particles into its two charge points (chargeParticleCreate) and fires a homing bullet of its color every 32 frames from the other two muzzles in turn while its count at 0x76 lasts (homingBulletFire). At 0 it plays its motions back and closes. ch3GunshipMove sets the attack byte only to 1 and 0.
Makes an enemy in list 3 (ch3GunshipUpdate, ch3GunshipDraw) with 20 hit points (enemyInit), with extra bytes of the given size at 0x13C. The caller sets its behaviour at 0x134.

The behaviour of ch3Gunship's enemies: moves down at the record's speed and below y -15 starts its attack. Then its y speed grows by 0.0125 a frame to 0.7, so that it turns and rises. Then it moves toward its side, faster by record word 7 a frame up to 0.25, while its rise slows by 0.005 a frame to 0.025. Past x 17.5 or -17.5 it stops, ends its attack and sinks, faster by 0.025 a frame up to 0.75, and it ends once out of view.

A stage script's record function of chapter 3's second script: makes a ch3GunshipCreate enemy with its y speed from record word 6, its sideways step from record word 7 and its side from record byte 0x39 (ch3GunshipMove).

The task of ch3RingsWave, which counts down its frames and ends when they run out. Once the count of its ring enemies is 0 with more than 120 frames left, it sends three ch1Enemy01Spawn enemies 21 frames apart, from x 12.5 or -12.5 on the side away from the ship (targetPlayerIndex). Then, while 120 or more frames are left, it mirrors them, switches the color and sends three more. Else it ends.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch3RingsWaveUpdate) with a count of ring enemies and a frame limit, which sends ch1Enemy01Spawn enemies from y 42.5 once the count is 0.
Places an enemy of ch3DoubleRings at the rings' centre plus two vectors, each a radius at an angle, plus a y offset, and sets its velocity from the move.

The behaviour of ch3DoubleRings' enemies: the centre moves down with the lanes, the first angle turns by 0x80 a frame and the second by its own step. Below y 37.5 its depth and its y offset ease to 0 over 128 frames. Below y 1.25 the centre slows by 0.95 a frame until the wave task (ch3RingsWave) ends. Then its first radius and its depth grow faster each frame, and it ends once out of view.
The function that ch3DoubleRings' enemies run at 0 hit points: lowers the count of their wave task (ch3RingsWave).

A record function of chapter 3's lanes: makes 24 enemies with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) in 12 pairs about a moving centre (ch3DoubleRingMove). The pairs sit on a ring of radius 17.5, a twelfth of a turn apart with every other pair moved on by a 24th. The two of a pair, one of each color, sit opposite on a ring of radius 5 that turns one way or the other by pair. A wave task (ch3RingsWave) with 1200 frames sends more enemies once all 24 are destroyed.

The behaviour of ch3Splitter's enemies: it can be hit after 17 frames. It falls with gravity 0.0035 a frame, bounces once off y -37.5 and bounces off the play area's sides. After its bounce, at stage part 2 or when a ship is lost, it ends once out of view.

The function that ch3Splitter's enemies run at 0 hit points: lowers their task's count and, before the third generation, makes two ch3Splitter enemies of the next generation in the same color, 5 to each side, flying apart at 1.125 times its x speed and up at 0.15.

Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) that bounces (ch3SplitterMove) and splits in two when destroyed (ch3SplitterSplit), with the record's velocity, its generation from record byte 0x39, explosion kind 0x42 and no hit record at first (flags 0x06 of byte 0x69). It raises its owner's count.

The task of ch3Splitters: every 25 frames it makes a ch3Splitter, from its two streams in turn, each stepping its x by 7.5 across -18.75 to 18.75, 12 in all. Then, once its count is below 8 or after 12 more steps, it switches both streams' colors and starts again. Each ch3Splitter raises the count and each one destroyed lowers it (ch3SplitterSplit), so the ones that leave the view stay counted. It ends at stage part 2.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch3SplittersUpdate) that sends bouncing enemies that split (ch3Splitter) from y 42.5. ch3MidBossUpdate makes it when the mid-boss bursts.
Starts chapter 3's first stage script, at 0x8C0E63FC (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at its start.
Starts chapter 3's second stage script, at 0x8C0E6494 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at the start of its second part.

Draws a segment of chapter 3's boss ring at the ring's kept matrix (0xD0), turned by its angle: model 0x40000 of bank 4 while whole, else the broken model 0x40001 with the second texture list when black. It files its hit record in list 3.
Makes a burst of explosions (explosionBurst) with sound 0x0D at a point of a segment of chapter 3's boss: at a distance along its angle from the boss's position, moving with the ring's turn.

The task of a segment of chapter 3's boss, which ends with the boss. At 0 hit points before the boss's timeout it bursts (ch3BossSegmentBurst) and breaks, raises the boss's limit for its arm turn speed (0x3C) by 4, 8 or 16 by difficulty and for its ring turn speed (0x3E) by twice that, and lowers the boss's counts of segments and of its color. Once the fight starts (boss byte 0x16) it takes damage and homing lasers can aim at it. Then, while whole and until the timeout, it fires a ch3BossBullet of its color inward every 16, 12 or 8 frames by difficulty, two from one of its two muzzles and then two from the other, each with an effect at that muzzle. After the boss's destruction a broken segment ends after a random delay, a white one with a burst.

Makes a segment of chapter 3's boss ring in list 3 (ch3BossSegmentUpdate, ch3BossSegmentDraw) at an angle, white (attribute 0x35) for argument 0 and else black (0x36), with 120 hit points (hitInitRegistered). It is filed also out of view (hit flag 0x100), and until the fight starts it is armoured and no target for homing lasers (0x82).

Draws chapter 3's boss at its position, turned a quarter turn about x: model 0x40003 of bank 4, faded by its alpha (0x08) until that is 1, until its destruction (byte 0x34). Turned by its angles, it keeps that matrix (0x90) for its arms and draws model 0x40002 turned by its spin (0x1C). Until its destruction's count reaches 16 it also draws model 0x40006, the segments' ring, turned by the ring's angle (0x24), and keeps that matrix (0xD0).
Brings the three turn speeds of chapter 3's boss (0x28, 0x2C and 0x30) one step toward 0 every other frame.

The task of chapter 3's boss (ch3BossCreate), in 9 steps. It makes 14 segments around its ring in alternating colors (ch3BossSegmentCreate) and 4 arms (ch3BossArmCreate), comes in, and starts a boss timer of 100 seconds (bossTimerCreate) and its walls (ch3BossWalls). After sounds and its music (sequencePlay 2) the fight starts. It turns its ring, its spin and its arms at speeds up to limits that the lost segments raise, and a lost ship (stageEvents 0x04) halves the limits of the ring and the arms, down to their first values. It moves by the ships' positions. With fewer than 7 segments left, or one color gone, it fires four lasers (enemyLaserCreate), two white and two black, with sounds 0x108 to 0x10A. With all segments destroyed it sets the boss state (bossStateSet 1), explodes and makes its destruction (bossDeathCreate). When the timer ends it stops its lasers, moves out, lowers the stage's lock (stageUnlock) and ends.
Makes chapter 3's boss, a task in list 3 (ch3BossUpdate, ch3BossDraw). Chapter 3's stage program calls it in its third part.
Draws an arm of chapter 3's boss: model 0x40005 at the boss's kept matrix (0x90), turned by the arm's angle about y and stretched in z by the boss's value at 0x0C. It keeps the arm's matrix (0x10).

The task of an arm of chapter 3's boss, which ends with the boss: once the boss's byte 0x14 is set it makes two blocks on the arm (ch3BossArmBlock) at distances by its kind, and it ends at the boss's destruction (byte 0x34). It keeps its angle at the boss's arm angle (0x20) plus its own.
Makes an arm of chapter 3's boss in list 3 (ch3BossArmUpdate, ch3BossArmDraw) at an angle, with its kind.
Draws a ch3BossArmBlock: model 0x40004 of bank 4 at its motion's frame, at its distance along its arm's matrix.
Places a ch3BossArmBlock at its distance from the boss's position along its arm's angle.

The task of a ch3BossArmBlock, which ends with its arm: it moves out to its distance in 128 frames, then steps its motion. On normal and hard, once fewer than 11 segments live, its motion stops and it slides back and forth along the arm by its amplitude, faster once fewer than 3 live. It adds its polygon, turned by the arm, to the scenery while the boss's byte 0x14 is set. At the boss's destruction (byte 0x34) it bursts (explosionBurst) and ends.
Makes a block in list 1 (ch3BossArmBlockUpdate, ch3BossArmBlockDraw) on an arm of chapter 3's boss, with a distance and an amplitude for its slide, and a polygon of 4 corners that the ships hit.

The task of ch3BossWalls, which ends with the boss or when the boss's byte 0x14 clears: each frame it adds its 14 fixed polygons, and its polygon of 8 corners turned by the boss's spin (0x1C), to the scenery at the boss's position.
Makes a task in list 1 (ch3BossWallsUpdate) with the walls of chapter 3's boss: 14 polygons of 4 corners around its ring, a fourteenth of a turn apart, and one of 8 corners.
Draws chapter 3's boss background of bank 10 (S03_BG02) with the fog flag: model 0xA0000 at z -119 and model 0xA0001 6 times, 80 apart further in -z.
The task of ch3Bg02Create's fixed part: ends once the scroll passes 500.
Draws the moving part of chapter 3's boss background with the fog flag: model 0xA0002 of bank 10, 7 times 160 apart in -z from its offset, and once the scroll passes 700 only the 3 farthest in -z.
The task of ch3Bg02Create's moving part: its speed grows by 0.001 a frame up to 0.5, and it moves its offset by that speed, wrapped at 160. Once the scroll passes 700 it draws fewer models.
Makes the two tasks in list 0 of chapter 3's boss background (ch3Bg02Update, ch3Bg02Draw, and ch3Bg02bUpdate, ch3Bg02bDraw). Chapter 3's stage program calls it at the start of its third part.

Draws a ch3BossBullet: sprite 0x10404 plus its frame, at its angle, with its depth value (word 3) plus or minus 0.00005 on alternate frames, opposite for white and black, and files its hit record in list 4.

The task of a ch3BossBullet: ends outside the play area. At 0 hit points a ship absorbed it (bulletAbsorbed). It vanishes (bulletVanish) after a distance, in the scenery (sceneryHit), when it hits or when the bullets vanish (stageEvents 0x02). Else it moves and steps its frame from 0 to 3 every other frame.
Fires a bullet in list 4 (ch3BossBulletUpdate, ch3BossBulletDraw) of a color from a position at an angle and a speed, with sprites 0x10404 to 0x10407 and one hit point.

Draws one ship of chapter 3's ship sequences that takes part, at the sequence's place and angles for it: on the path in the camera's mode 0, or in the play field in mode 1. It keeps that matrix for its side effects and draws the ship's model (shipModelDraw) while the ship's state is below 3 and forced flag 0x04 is set.
The draw of chapter 3's ship sequences (ch3ShipsA, ch3ShipsB): both ships (ch3ShipsDrawOne).

Moves one ship of a chapter 3 ship sequence from its start to its target place and angles by the cosine of the sequence's phase (pointBlendCos), or puts it at the target once the phase reaches 0x8000.
Moves both ships of a chapter 3 ship sequence (ch3ShipsBlendOne), and returns 1 once the phase reaches 0x8000.
Makes a shock ring (shockRingCreate, 31 segments) at a ship of ch3ShipsA, with a texture by its argument.
Makes a second kind of shock ring (shockRingCreate, 31 segments) at a ship of ch3ShipsA, with a texture by its argument.
Makes the two side effects (shipSideEffectCreate) of one ship of ch3ShipsA that takes part, and keeps them.
Sets the first move of one ship of ch3ShipsA: from its place and angles, turned a quarter turn about x, to a place and angles from tables by its order. It sets forced flag 0x04 in any case.
Slows one ship of a chapter 3 ship sequence that takes part down to speed 0, and keeps its position as the start of its move.
Sets the next move of one ship of ch3ShipsA: from where its last move ended to a place and angles from tables by its order.

A step of ch3ShipsA for one ship: at frame 120 or 150 by its order it moves its side effects on (byte 0x27). 8 frames later it makes a shock ring in the ship's polarity (ch3ShipsRing1), and 24 frames after that a second one (ch3ShipsRing2). Then it ends the first, moves the side effects on again, starts the ship's spin and plays sound 0x11.
Sets the last move of one ship of ch3ShipsA: from where its last move ended to x -10 for ship 0 or 10 for ship 1 at y -20, with a turn about z to -0x30000 or 0x30000 by its order.
Places a point on one ship of ch3ShipsA, on the path at the ship's place and angles, where its shock rings appear.

The task of ch3ShipsA, in 5 steps for both ships (ch3ShipsAStart, ch3ShipsSlow, ch3ShipsSideEffects, ch3ShipsATargetSet, ch3ShipsARings, ch3ShipsAFinalSet and ch3ShipsBlend). At frame 22 it puts the camera on the path (mode 0) and eases the camera values at 0x8C1D1510, 0x8C1D14FC and 0x8C1D1500. At its end it puts the camera in mode 1 and the ships at their places with a turn effect (playerTurnEffect), clears their forced flags and input, sets their speed to 0.5 and their hp to 1, lets players join again and ends.

Makes a task in list 2 that takes both ships through chapter 3's first sequence (ch3ShipsAUpdate, ch3ShipsDraw), with the player of the higher score first in a game with two players. It sets the ships' forced flags 0x02, 0x08 and 0x20, clears their shot, switch and release input, stops joining and sets stageEvents 0x0A. Chapter 3's stage program calls it at scroll position 485.

Sets the first move of one ship of ch3ShipsB: from its place and angles to a place from a table by the ship's index, with a turn about z toward its side of x. It keeps 0x60 a frame toward that side (0xA0), which ch3ShipsBUpdate adds to the move's z angle, and it sets forced flag 0x04 in any case.
Sets the last move of one ship of ch3ShipsB: from where its last move ended to x -10 for ship 0 or 10 for ship 1, with a turn about z to -0x20000 or 0x20000 by the sign of its z angle.

The task of ch3ShipsB, in 5 steps for both ships (ch3ShipsBStart, ch3ShipsSlow, ch3ShipsBFinalSet and ch3ShipsBlend). At frame 22 it starts the ships' first move, then their last, and then waits 31 frames, as it steps its frame counter twice a frame there. At its end it puts the ships at their places with a turn effect (playerTurnEffect), clears their forced flags and input, sets their speed to 0.5 and their hp to 1, lets players join again and ends.

Makes a task in list 2 that takes the ships in play through chapter 3's second sequence (ch3ShipsBUpdate, ch3ShipsDraw). In a game with two players it ranks them by score as ch3ShipsA does, but the steps of its task use only whether a ship takes part. It sets the ships' forced flags 0x02, 0x08 and 0x20, clears their shot, switch and release input, stops joining and sets stageEvents 0x0A. Chapter 3's stage program calls it in its third part at scroll position 125.
Loads bank 8 under the name S04_BG00 from the file list at 0x8C0EA580, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 2 under the name S04_OBJ00 from the file list at 0x8C0EA354, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 3 under the name S04_OBJ01 from the file list at 0x8C0EA540, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads banks 8 (S04_BG00), 2 (S04_OBJ00) and 3 (S04_OBJ01) at once. sceneChapter4Start calls it.

Sets chapter 4's light (its two angles at 0, color 1, 0.8, 0.6, intensity and ambient, and for the multi-light models the color of light 1 and three more values), and the fog's color to 60, 30, 0, its depths (fogTableSet) and the fade's level 0, with byte 4 of ninjaFadeLevel at 0, and sets fogFadeOn. sceneChapter4Start calls it.
Fades the fog to color 60, 30, 0 with depths -60 and -700 in 60 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at scroll position 2500.

Fades the fog to color 40, 25, 0 with depths -30 and -220, and the lights to angles -0x2000 and 0 with color 1, 0.8, 0.6 for the main light and for light 1, in 200 frames (fogFadeTo, lightsFadeTo). Chapter 4's stage program calls it in its second part at scroll position 3537.66.

Fades the fog to color 60, 30, 0 with depths -60 and -600, and the lights to angles 0 and 0 with color 1, 0.8, 0.6, in 500 frames (fogFadeTo, lightsFadeTo). Chapter 4's stage program calls it in its third part at scroll position 3887.66.
Fades the fog to color 60, 30, 0 with depths -20 and -170 in 300 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 4's stage program calls it in its third part.
Fades the fog to color 100, 60, 20 with depths -60 and -600 in 300 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at the start of its fourth part.
Fades the fog to color 60, 30, 0 with depths -60 and -600 in 180 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 4's stage program calls it in its fourth part.
Starts chapter 4's music (sequencePlay 10) and plays sound 0x10A. Chapter 4's stage program calls it at its start.
Shows the left band with bank 8's sprites 0x80000 to 0x80003 (leftBandCreate). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at scroll position 2575.
Plays sound 0x101 (soundPlay). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at the start of its third part.
Plays sound 0x102 (soundPlay). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at the start of its fourth part.
Plays sound 0x100 (soundPlay). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at scroll position 2250.
Plays sound 0x101 as an effect (soundEffect). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at scroll position 5395.
Plays sound 0x103 (soundPlay). Chapter 4's stage program calls it near its end.
Plays sound 0x3A (soundPlay). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at scroll position 2300.
Fades the music of sequence slot 0 out (sequenceSetVolume to -127 over 0x4000). Chapter 4's stage program calls it.
Draws a ch4GunshipCreate enemy as ch3GunshipDraw does, with model 0x30000 of bank 3.

The task of a ch4GunshipCreate enemy, as ch3GunshipUpdate with model 0x30000 of bank 3: at 0 hit points it calls enemyKill, plays sound 0x108 and ends. Each burst of homing bullets also plays sound 0x107.
Makes an enemy in list 3 (ch4GunshipUpdate, ch4GunshipDraw) with 20 hit points (enemyInit), with extra bytes of the given size at 0x13C. The caller sets its behaviour at 0x134.

The behaviour of ch4Gunship's enemies: after the frames of record byte 0x39 it starts its attack, with 4 bursts of homing bullets when record byte 0x3A is set, else with sprite bullets. Over 64 frames it then comes forward from its depth to z 0 while it turns a full turn about z, and its x speed changes from record word 6 to record word 7. After that, with record byte 0x3A its x speed slows by 0.975 a frame until its bursts are done. Then it stops its attack, its x speed changes by (word 6 - word 7) / 128 a frame without a limit, and it turns about z by 2048 times its x speed a frame. Without record byte 0x3A it keeps its x speed and its attack. It ends once out of view.
A stage script's record function of chapter 4: makes a ch4GunshipCreate enemy that comes forward and attacks (ch4GunshipMove).
The behaviour of ch4StreamEnemy's enemies: adds its acceleration to its velocity and moves, turned by its x speed, and ends below y 30 once out of view.
Makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) with its velocity from record words 6 and 7 and its acceleration from record words 8 and 9 (ch4StreamEnemyMove).
The task of ch4Stream: every 8 frames it makes, in turn, one ch4StreamEnemy at its record's place and two, 7.5 to each side and apart in y. It ends after the count of record byte 0x3F.
A stage script's record function of chapter 4: makes a task in list 3 (ch4StreamUpdate) with a copy of the record that sends accelerating enemies.
The behaviour of ch4Veerer's enemies: moves by its velocity, and below y 0 it adds its x acceleration to its x speed and turns about z by its x speed. It ends below y 30 once out of view.

A stage script's record function of chapter 4: makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) with the record's velocity (words 6 and 7) that veers by its x acceleration (word 8) below y 0 (ch4VeererMove).

The behaviour of ch4Reverser's enemies: waits its frames, then over 64 frames its y speed turns back while it swings across, half a turn of its phase. It ends once out of view, or when it meets the scenery, where it explodes (enemyExplosion) with sound 0x10B.

A stage script's record function of chapter 4: makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) at the record's x plus record word 6, that comes in at the y speed of record word 7. After the frames of record byte 0x39 it turns back while it swings to the record's x minus record word 6 (ch4ReverserMove).

The behaviour of ch4Zigzag's enemies, in steps of its frames: it moves down 7, turns a quarter turn toward its side in 8 frames, moves 8 sideways, ends at x 3.5 or -3.5, turns back and switches sides. It ends below y 30 once out of view.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) that zigzags down (ch4ZigzagMove), its side from record byte 0x39 and its frames for each move from record byte 0x3A.

The task of ch4ZigzagPairs: after 301 frames it sends 18 pairs of ch4Zigzag enemies, 3.5 to each side of the record's x, in a color pattern partly at random. Each pair's moves take a frame less than the last pair's, from 20 down to 10. Each pair comes 22 frames plus 3 times its move frames after the last pair.
A stage script's record function of chapter 4: makes a task in list 3 (ch4ZigzagPairsUpdate) with a copy of the record that sends pairs of zigzagging enemies.

The behaviour of ch4Dasher's enemies: moves for 17 frames, then for 17 frames slows by 0.875 a frame while it turns halfway toward a ship each frame (aimAtPlayer). Then it aims at the ship, speeds up along that angle by 0.05 a frame up to 1, and ends once out of view.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) with the record's velocity (words 6 and 7) that stops, aims and dashes at a ship (ch4DasherMove).

A stage script's record function of chapter 4: makes a ch4Dasher that moves in at 1 along the record's angle (word 4), from 50 out from the centre on the opposite side, with its y position stretched by 1.125. On easy, record byte 0x3F skips it.

The task of ch4DasherRing: after 201 frames it makes 63 ch4Dasher enemies 50 out from the centre, with their y stretched by 1.125, moving in at 1, the angle of their place turning back by 0x1200 each time from 0x2800. They come in groups of 3, 9 frames apart and 25 frames between groups, three of one color and three of the other.
A stage script's record function of chapter 4: makes a task in list 3 (ch4DasherRingUpdate) with a copy of the record that sends dashing enemies from all around.
Starts chapter 4's first stage script, at 0x8C0E7728 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at its start.
Starts chapter 4's second stage script, at 0x8C0E8010 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at the start of its third part.
Starts chapter 4's third stage script, at 0x8C0E9608 (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at the start of its fourth part.

The task of ch4FortressScenery: each frame it adds to the scenery, with origin 0,0, its first polygon (x -30 to 30, y 30 to 40), and while the fortress's byte 0x2E is set its two side blocks (x -30 to -24.5 and 24.5 to 30, y 1.5 to 10.5). It ends when the fortress's byte 0x2D clears.
Makes a task in list 1 (ch4FortressSceneryUpdate) with three polygons of 4 corners for chapter 4's fortress.
The node function that a ch4FortressCannon gives node 15 of the fortress's tree: keeps the node's matrix at 0x2F4, where ch4FortressDraw draws model 0x20008.
The node function that a ch4FortressCannon gives node 17 of the fortress's tree: keeps the node's matrix at 0x334, where ch4FortressDraw draws model 0x20009.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 47: turns its part about y by minus the fortress's angle (0x10) and keeps that matrix at 0xB4, where ch4WheelDraw draws the wheel.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 48: keeps the node's matrix at 0xF4.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 30: keeps the node's matrix at 0x134.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 31: keeps the node's matrix at 0x174.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 32: keeps the node's matrix at 0x1B4.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 33: keeps the node's matrix at 0x1F4.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 34: keeps the node's matrix at 0x234.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 35: keeps the node's matrix at 0x274.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 37: keeps the node's matrix at 0x2B4.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 36: moves its part in y by the fortress's value at 0x378.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 39: moves its part in z by the fortress's value at 0x37C.
A node function of the fortress's tree for node 40: moves its part in z by minus the fortress's value at 0x37C.

Draws chapter 4's fortress with the fog flag: at its position it keeps the matrix at 0x74, then turns by its angle (0x10) about y and draws model 0x20001 of bank 2 through its node tree at its motion (byte 0x2A) and frame (0x34). While byte 0x3D is set (cannon 0 destroyed) it also draws model 0x20008 at the kept matrix of node 15, and while byte 0x3E is set (cannon 1) model 0x20009 at that of node 17.
Makes the guns of chapter 4's fortress: two ch4FortressCannon guns, white and black, and four ch4FortressTurret guns in two colors, and sets their counts (bytes 0x3C and 0x3F).

The task of ch4FortressWatch: until the fortress's step reaches 12, it raises the fortress's difficulty value (byte 0x28) by one when a ship is lost, up to 4. A higher value gives the turrets and drones longer fire intervals.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch4FortressWatchUpdate) for chapter 4's fortress.

The task of chapter 4's fortress (ch4FortressCreate), in 21 steps, which its wheel and its core also move on. Moved on by its wheel, it swings in the background. After the wheel's pod fight it lowers the stage's lock (stageUnlock), moves to its place, turning to angle 0x10000, and makes its guns (ch4FortressGuns). Past a scroll position it makes its scenery (ch4FortressScenery) with sound 0x102, opens with sound 0x103 and launches 54 drones (ch4FortressDrone) in color patterns. Then it closes, plays sound 0x10B, sets its guns to fire and starts a 30-second boss timer. When its guns are destroyed or the timer ends, it lowers the stage's lock and moves to its last place, turning a full turn. Past another scroll position it starts a 100-second boss timer and its music (sequencePlay 2) and turns until the timer ends or its core is destroyed, then lowers the stage's lock. Destroyed, it sets the boss state (bossStateSet 1), explodes, makes its destruction (bossDeathCreate) at frame 800 and ends at frame 980. Else it lowers the lock again at frame 980.
Frees the node tree of chapter 4's fortress when its task ends.

Makes chapter 4's fortress, a task in list 0 (ch4FortressUpdate, ch4FortressDraw): model 0x20001 of bank 2 with a node tree and its node functions, its wheel (ch4WheelCreate) and its core (ch4CoreCreate). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at its start.
Draws ch4WheelHub: files the wheel's hit record (0x38) in list 3 at the wheel's position.
The task of ch4WheelHub: ends with the wheel, or when the wheel's byte 0x0A clears.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch4WheelHubUpdate, ch4WheelHubDraw) that files the hit record of chapter 4's wheel.

Draws chapter 4's wheel while the fortress's byte 0x26 is set, at the fortress's hub matrix (ch4FortressNodeHub): it places its centre and 16 points on the play field (pointToPlane). While its byte 0x3B1 is set it also keeps a matrix next to each point for its glow (ch4WheelGlow) and charge (ch4WheelCharge). It draws model 0x20000 turned by its angle (0x18) and its 5 arms, model 0x20003 through node trees, a fifth of a turn apart and turned by the arms' angle (0x20), each pushed out by its extension while it lives.
Breaks an arm of chapter 4's wheel: a burst of explosions (explosionBurst) at its tip with sound 0x10A for arm 4, else 0x10C, and the arm is gone (byte 0x184 plus the arm).

Sends orbiting enemies around chapter 4's wheel (ch4WheelOrbiter) every 36 frames while the fortress swings, more on normal and hard, from the fortress's swing angle (0x20). It uses two patterns that turn opposite ways, the second from swing angle 0x9000. At rounds 16, 36, 67 and 87 it also sends 12 at once in groups of three that turn both ways.

Sends enemies around chapter 4's wheel in steps once the fortress's swing angle (0x20) passes 0x6000: pairs that turn both ways (ch4WheelSpinner), and rows of six at one angle that turn both ways, change radius and turn back (ch4WheelSwitcher).
Draws ch4WheelGlow: its sprite at each of the wheel's 16 kept points, white and black in turn, at a random size near its size and at its alpha.

The task of ch4WheelGlow, which ends with the wheel: it fades in by 5 a frame and grows until the wheel's byte 6 is set. Then it fades out by 20 a frame and shrinks, and ends, clearing the wheel's byte 0x3B1.
Makes a task in list 4 (ch4WheelGlowUpdate, ch4WheelGlowDraw) with a sprite and a size, that glows at the 16 points of chapter 4's wheel.
Every other frame, makes charge particles (chargeParticleCreate) into each of the 16 points of chapter 4's wheel, white and black in turn.
Makes an effect sprite (effectFollowScaled) at each of the 16 points of chapter 4's wheel, white and black in turn.
The task of ch4WheelWait: ends once the wheel's step passes 7.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch4WheelWaitUpdate) that lives until the wheel's step passes 7. The wheel makes it the owner of its link bullets (linkBulletCreate), which vanish when it ends.

The task of chapter 4's wheel (ch4WheelCreate), which ends with the fortress, in 12 steps. Past a scroll position it starts its hub (ch4WheelHub), sends orbiting enemies (ch4WheelOrbiter) every 32 frames in 48 rounds and glows (ch4WheelGlow), then moves the fortress on. While the fortress swings it sends more waves (ch4WheelOrbitWaves, ch4WheelSpinnerWaves), and near the swing's end its arms break off (ch4WheelArmBurst). At the swing's end it moves the fortress on, makes a 45-second boss timer (bossTimerCreate) and the owner of its link bullets (ch4WheelWait), charges with sounds 0x107 and 0x109 (ch4WheelCharge, ch4WheelFlash) and opens 12 pods in alternating colors (ch4WheelPod), which starts the timer. With all pods destroyed it bursts (explosionBurst) with sound 0x10D, else the pods leave when the timer ends, and it moves the fortress on. Past another scroll position its hub ends and it stops its turn at a multiple of a half turn. It turns its arms and adds their polygons to the scenery until they break. From its 16 points it fires bullets (ch4Bullet), and after the charge link bullets (linkBulletCreate).
Frees the 5 node trees of chapter 4's wheel when its task ends.

Makes chapter 4's wheel in list 1 (ch4WheelUpdate, ch4WheelDraw) for the fortress: 5 arms with node trees of model 0x20003 and polygons of 7 corners that the ships hit, and an armoured white hit record of 100 hit points at its hub.
Draws a ch4WheelPod: model 0x20004 of bank 2, turned a quarter turn about x and by its angle, and files its hit record in list 3 while in view.
Places a ch4WheelPod at its distance from the wheel's centre along its angle, and its muzzle a little further out, and sets its velocity from the move.

The task of a ch4WheelPod. At 0 hit points it lowers the wheel's pod count, calls enemyDestroyed, plays sound 0x109 and ends. Else it moves out from distance 7.5 to 12.5 by 0.25 a frame. From then, after 129 frames, it fires a bullet of its color outward from its muzzle (bulletFireAt1030c) every 37 frames on easy, else every 25, and 12 frames more for each ship lost. When the wheel's byte 0x0D is set, it becomes armoured and not aimed at (hit flags 0x82), moves back in to 7.5 and ends. It turns with the wheel (ch4WheelPodPlace).
Makes a pod of chapter 4's wheel in list 3 (ch4WheelPodUpdate, ch4WheelPodDraw) at an angle, white or black, with 20 hit points (hitInitRegistered), its first shot delayed by its index.
Places an enemy that orbits chapter 4's wheel at its radius along its angle from the wheel's centre, and sets its velocity from the move.

The behaviour of ch4WheelOrbiter's enemies: they turn about the wheel by their step (ch4WheelOrbitPlace). At their fire frame, when the ship is far enough (targetFartherThan), they fire a bullet of their color at it. They end after 0x12000 of turn, or after half a turn once outside the play area.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) that orbits chapter 4's wheel (ch4WheelOrbiterMove), with a radius, a color, a start angle, a step and a fire frame, and explosion kind 0x42.

The behaviour of ch4WheelSpinner's enemies: they turn about the wheel by their step (ch4WheelOrbitPlace), facing along their way and spinning, and end after a full turn, or after half a turn once outside the play area.

Makes an enemy with model 0x10004 (enemyModel4Create) that orbits chapter 4's wheel with a behaviour, a radius, a color, a start angle and a step. A last argument of 0 gives it explosion flags 0x42, else 0xC2.
Makes a ch4WheelOrbiter4 enemy that turns about the wheel facing its way (ch4WheelSpinnerMove).

The behaviour of ch4WheelSwitcher's enemies: they turn about the wheel (ch4WheelOrbitPlace). After half a turn, over 64 frames they change their radius and their turn eases into the other way. They end after a full turn, or after half a turn once outside the play area.
Makes a ch4WheelOrbiter4 enemy that turns about the wheel, then changes radius and turns back (ch4WheelSwitcherMove), with the direction of its radius change.
A node function of a ch4FortressCannon's tree for node 2: turns its part by the cannon's angle plus half a turn about y, and places the cannon's position and muzzle on the play field (pointToPlane).

Draws a ch4FortressCannon at the fortress's kept matrix of node 30 or 31: model 0x20005 of bank 2 through its node tree at its motion's frame (enemyModelDrawEach). It files its hit record in list 3 while the fortress plays motion 2.

The task of a ch4FortressCannon, which ends when the fortress's byte 0x30 is set. At 0 hit points it lowers the fortress's cannon count, calls enemyKill, plays sound 0x10C, shows its broken model on the fortress (ch4FortressNodeKeep15 or ch4FortressNodeKeep17) and ends. While the fortress's mode (byte 0x2F) is 1 it opens. Once open, it raises the fortress's count of open cannons (byte 0x41) once, turns toward a ship faster up to 24 a frame and every 6 frames fires a fan of 5 sprite bullets of its color on easy, else 7 (bulletSpriteFireAt10508), with a flash. In mode 2 it closes and turns back to 0x8000.
Frees the node tree of a ch4FortressCannon when its task ends.

Makes a cannon of chapter 4's fortress in list 3 (ch4FortressCannonUpdate, ch4FortressCannonDraw): model 0x20005 with a node tree (ch4CannonNode), white or black, with 120 hit points (hitInitRegistered), on node 30 or 31 by its index.
A node function of a ch4FortressTurret's tree for node 1: turns its part by the turret's angle about y, and places the turret's position and muzzle on the play field (pointToPlane).

Draws a ch4FortressTurret at the fortress's kept matrix of node 32 plus its index: model 0x20006 of bank 2 through its node tree (enemyModelDrawTree). It files its hit record in list 3 while the fortress plays motion 2.

The task of a ch4FortressTurret, which ends when the fortress's byte 0x30 is set. At 0 hit points it lowers the fortress's turret count, calls enemyKill, plays sound 0x10A and ends. While the fortress's byte 0x31 is set it sweeps its angle back and forth between -0x8000 and 0x8000, a full turn, by 0x120 a frame. It fires a bullet of its color along it (bulletFire) with an effect sprite (effectFollowScaled) every 4 to 25 frames by the fortress's difficulty value (byte 0x28). A turret that sweeps toward -0x8000 fires its first shot after about half that interval, the others at once.
Frees the node tree of a ch4FortressTurret when its task ends.

Makes a turret of chapter 4's fortress in list 3 (ch4FortressTurretUpdate, ch4FortressTurretDraw): model 0x20006 with a node tree (ch4TurretNode), white or black, with 60 hit points (hitInitRegistered), on a node by its index, sweeping one way or the other.
Makes a ch4FortressDrone explode (enemyExplosion) with sound 0x10B, its x speed turned back.
A node function of a ch4FortressDrone's tree for node 1: turns its part by the drone's angle plus half a turn about y, and places its muzzle on the play field (pointToPlane).

Draws a ch4FortressDrone on the fortress's rail (the kept matrix of node 37), moved along it by its distance: model 0x20007 through its node tree (enemyModelDrawTree). Before that, it crashes (ch4DroneCrash) and ends when it comes within 3 of the furthest drone from the other end, at the latest when its distance passes 46 (end 0) or falls below 8 (end 1). It files its hit record in list 3 while its distance lies between 5 and 49.

The task of a ch4FortressDrone. At 0 hit points it calls enemyDestroyed, plays sound 6 and ends. Else it slides along the rail by 0.1 a frame and keeps the furthest distance of its end in the fortress (byte 0x44 for end 0, byte 0x48 for end 1, which the fortress sets back to 5 and 49 each frame). While its distance lies between 5 and 49 it can be hit, turns toward a ship and fires a bullet of its color with an effect sprite (effectFollowScaled) every 13 to 31 frames by the fortress's difficulty value (byte 0x28).
Frees the node tree of a ch4FortressDrone when its task ends.

Makes a drone of chapter 4's fortress in list 3 (ch4FortressDroneUpdate, ch4FortressDroneDraw): model 0x20007 with a node tree (ch4DroneNode), white or black, with 8 hit points (hitInitRegistered), starting at one end of the rail by its argument.

The task of ch4CoreWalls, which ends when the core's byte 0x3F0 clears. Each frame it adds the core's round polygon to the scenery at the point of the fortress's node 48 (0x8C1EA4D8). It adds three walls a third of a turn apart, turned by the core's angle (0x3EC), 5.5 from the core's centre (0x8C1EA4CC).
Makes a task in list 1 (ch4CoreWallsUpdate) for the walls of chapter 4's core.
Sets up a petal of chapter 4's core: four plates of 80 hit points each in alternating colors (hitInitRegistered), armoured and not aimed at (hit flags 0x82).

Draws a petal of chapter 4's core: its plates up to the one after its current plate (byte 0), models 0x2000D down to 0x2000A, each turned about x by its opening. While the core's byte 0x3F0 is set, it files the hit records of the current and later plates in list 3.

Updates a petal of chapter 4's core. When its current plate is at 0 hit points, the plate opens a quarter turn and the next one loses hit flags 0x82 (armour, not aimed at). After the last plate the core's own hit record loses them, and the petal's stretch (byte 4) grows by 0.01 a frame to 1. Else the plate opens by its share of 80 hit points lost.
Places point N of chapter 4's core (0x67C plus 12 times N) on the play field (pointToPlane). The core's node functions call it.
Scales a part of chapter 4's core in z by petal N's stretch, which grows from 0 to 1 after its last plate breaks. The core's node functions call it.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodeStretch for petal 0.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodeStretch for petal 2.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodeStretch for petal 1.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodePoint for point 0.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodePoint for point 1.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodePoint for point 2.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodePoint for point 3.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodePoint for point 4.
A node function of chapter 4's core tree: ch4CoreNodePoint for point 5.

Draws chapter 4's core while the fortress's byte 0x27 is set, at the fortress's kept matrix of node 48. It places the node's origin on the play field (0x8C1EA4D8), the centre of the core's swing. Moved by its swing, turned and scaled by 0.5 in y, it places its own centre (0x8C1EA4CC), draws model 0x20002 through its node tree and files its hit record in list 3. While it has hit points, is hit and is not armoured, it draws glow sprite 0x10A02. Then it draws its three petals a third of a turn apart (ch4CorePetalDraw).

Moves chapter 4's core: while its byte 0x46 is set, every 4 frames it fires core bullets (ch4CoreBullet) in two colors with effect sprites from 6 points, two for each petal, but not from the two of a petal whose laser is on. It swings and turns the core by the fortress's turn speed, sets the fortress's x from the swing, places its three laser points and updates its petals (ch4CorePetalUpdate).

The task of chapter 4's core (ch4CoreCreate), which ends with the fortress, in 7 steps. In the fortress's last fight it makes 14 emitters (ch4Emitter) around the centre of its swing with sounds 0x104 and 0x106, starts its walls (ch4CoreWalls) and the fortress's timer, and takes the armour off the first plate of each petal. It then moves out and back in, round after round (ch4CoreMove). From the second round on, it reverses the fortress's turn in each round and fires core bullets. On normal and hard, each petal that has lost all four plates fires a white laser once in each round (enemyLaserCreate) with sound 0x108. At 0 hit points it bursts (explosionBurst) with sound 0x105 and moves the fortress on. When destroyed or when the timer ends, it stops its sounds, its fire, its emitters and its walls, sets flag 0x40 (no shots) on both ships, and the bullets vanish.
Frees the node tree of chapter 4's core when its task ends.

Makes chapter 4's core in list 3 (ch4CoreUpdate, ch4CoreDraw) for the fortress: model 0x20002 of bank 2 with a node tree and its node functions, a white hit record of 600 hit points on easy, else 800 (hitInitRegistered), armoured at first, a round polygon of 16 corners and three walls of 8 corners, and three petals (ch4CorePetalInit).
Places a ch4Emitter on a circle of 42.5 about the centre of the core's swing (0x8C1EA4D8) at its angle plus the fortress's angle, facing that centre.

The task of a ch4Emitter, which ends when the core's byte 0x3F0 clears. Each frame it places itself (ch4EmitterPlace) and adds its polygon, turned by its angle, to the scenery. While the core's byte 0x47 is set, every 8 frames it fires an emitter shot (ch4EmitterShot) with a flash, in a color pattern by difficulty and bit 0 of its kind.
Makes an emitter in list 1 (ch4EmitterUpdate) at an angle about chapter 4's core, with a polygon of one of two shapes by bit 0x80 of its kind and a color by bit 0.
Draws a ch4EmitterShot: its sprite at its angle and size with flags by its color, and files its hit record in list 4.
Whether a point lies within 26 of the core's centre.
Places a ch4EmitterShot at its distance from its emitter along the emitter's angle.

The task of a ch4EmitterShot. At 0 hit points a ship absorbed it (bulletAbsorbed). When it reaches the core (ch4EmitterShotAtCore) it bursts (effectBurst) and ends. It vanishes (bulletVanish) when its emitter's task ends, when it hits or when the bullets vanish. Else it moves along its emitter (ch4EmitterShotPlace) and steps its sprite through 0x11000 to 0x11007 every other frame.
Fires a shot in list 4 (ch4EmitterShotUpdate, ch4EmitterShotDraw) of a color from a ch4Emitter, moving along the emitter's angle at a speed, with one hit point.
Draws a ch4CoreBullet: sprite 0x10404 plus its frame at its angle, and files its hit record in list 4.

The task of a ch4CoreBullet: ends outside the play area. At 0 hit points a ship absorbed it (bulletAbsorbed). Away from the core's centre it vanishes in the scenery, and it vanishes when it hits or when the bullets vanish. Else it moves and steps its frame from 0 to 3 every other frame.
Fires a bullet in list 4 (ch4CoreBulletUpdate, ch4CoreBulletDraw) of a color from a position at an angle and a speed, with sprites 0x10404 to 0x10407 and one hit point.
Whether a ch4Bullet lies near a ship in the game.

Draws a ch4Bullet inside the play area: sprite 0x10404 plus its frame at its angle, at a depth that alternates every frame, opposite for white and black. It files its hit record in list 4 only near a ship (ch4BulletNearShip) and on every other frame, alternate ones for white and black.

The task of a ch4Bullet: ends outside the play area. At 0 hit points a ship absorbed it (bulletAbsorbed). It vanishes (bulletVanish) in the scenery, when it hits or when the bullets vanish (stageEvents 0x02). Else it moves and steps its frame from 0 to 3 every other frame.
Fires a bullet in list 4 (ch4BulletUpdate, ch4BulletDraw) of a color from a position at an angle and a speed, with sprites 0x10404 to 0x10407 and one hit point.

Draws one ship of chapter 4's ship sequences that takes part, at the sequence's place and angles for it in the play field. It keeps that matrix for its side effects and draws the ship's model (shipModelDraw) while the ship's state is below 3 and forced flag 0x04 is set.
The draw of chapter 4's ship sequences (ch4ShipsA, ch4ShipsB): both ships (ch4ShipsDrawOne).
Moves one ship of a chapter 4 ship sequence from its start to its target place and angles by the cosine of the sequence's phase (pointBlendCos).
Moves both ships of a chapter 4 ship sequence (ch4ShipsBlendOne), and returns 1 once the phase reaches 0x8000.
Makes a shock ring (shockRingCreate, 31 segments) at a ship of ch4ShipsA, with a texture by its argument.
Makes a second kind of shock ring (shockRingCreate, 31 segments) at a ship of ch4ShipsA, with a texture by its argument.
Sets the first move of one ship of ch4ShipsA that takes part and makes its two side effects (shipSideEffectCreate). It sets forced flag 0x04 in any case.
Slows one ship of a chapter 4 ship sequence that takes part down to speed 0, and keeps its position as the start of its move.
Sets the next move of one ship of ch4ShipsA from its last move's end to a place by its order, and moves its side effects on a step.

Step 2 of ch4ShipsA for one ship: on the step's 8th frame (38th for the second in order) it makes a shock ring in the ship's polarity (ch4ShipsRing1). On the 32nd (62nd) it ends it, makes a second one (ch4ShipsRing2) with sound 0x11 and moves the ship's side effects on a step.
Sets the last move of one ship of ch4ShipsA from where its last move ended.

The task of ch4ShipsA, in 5 steps for both ships (ch4ShipsAStart, ch4ShipsSlow, ch4ShipsATargetSet, ch4ShipsARings, ch4ShipsAFinalSet and ch4ShipsBlend). At frame 22 it starts the ships' first move. At its end it puts the ships at their places with a turn effect (playerTurnEffect), clears their forced flags and input, sets their hp to 1, lets players join again and ends.

Makes a task in list 2 that takes both ships through chapter 4's first sequence (ch4ShipsAUpdate, ch4ShipsDraw), with the player of the higher score first in a game with two players. It sets the ships' forced flags 0x02, 0x08 and 0x20, clears their shot, switch and release input, stops joining and sets stageEvents 0x0A. Chapter 4's stage program calls it after scroll position 2500.
Sets the first move of one ship of ch4ShipsB that takes part. It sets forced flag 0x04 in any case.
Sets the last move of one ship of ch4ShipsB from where its last move ended.

The task of ch4ShipsB, in steps for both ships (ch4ShipsBStart, ch4ShipsSlow, ch4ShipsBFinalSet and ch4ShipsBlend). At frame 22 it starts the ships' first move, then their last. On the 61st frame after the last move, it puts the ships at their places with a turn effect (playerTurnEffect), clears their forced flags and input, sets their hp to 1, lets players join again and ends.

Makes a task in list 2 that takes both ships through chapter 4's second sequence (ch4ShipsBUpdate, ch4ShipsDraw), for the players in the game. With two players it also sets an order by score as ch4ShipsA does, but this sequence places each ship by its player. It sets the ships' forced flags 0x02, 0x08 and 0x20, clears their shot, switch and release input, stops joining and sets stageEvents 0x0A. Chapter 4's stage program calls it in its fourth part at scroll position 5211.7.
Draws ch4Sky: the 12 models of the list at 0x8C0EA174 (modelListDraw) at its owner's kept matrix.
The task of ch4Sky: ends with its owner.
Makes a task in list 5 with level 0x81 (ch4SkyUpdate, ch4SkyDraw) that draws chapter 4's sky at its owner's matrix.
The draw of ch4SkyTurn: keeps a matrix turned about y by its angle plus the fortress's turn (0x8C1EA4E4).
The task of ch4SkyTurn: turns its angle by -8 a frame.
Makes a task in list 0 (ch4SkyTurnUpdate, ch4SkyTurnDraw) that turns chapter 4's sky, and the sky's draw task (ch4Sky). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at its start, through ch4SkyTurnJump.
Jumps to ch4SkyTurn (a stub of mov.l and jmp). Chapter 4's stage program calls it at its start.
Loads bank 2 under the name S05_OBJ00 from the file list at 0x8C107BCC, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 3 under the name S05_OBJ01 from the file list at 0x8C107C78, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 4 under the name S05_OBJ02 from the file list at 0x8C107D9C, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 5 under the name S05_OBJ03 from the file list at 0x8C107E2C, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode). sceneChapter5Start calls it.
Loads bank 8 under the name S05_BG00 from the file list at 0x8C107E9C, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 9 under the name S05_BG01 from the file list at 0x8C107F1C, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads bank 10 under the name S05_BG02 from the file list at 0x8C107FE0, at once with 0 or else over frames (bankLoadMode).
Loads banks 8 (S05_BG00) and 2 (S05_OBJ00) at once and banks 9 (S05_BG01) and 3 (S05_OBJ01) over frames. Chapter 5's stage program calls it at its start.
Frees banks 2 and 8 (bankFree). Chapter 5's stage program calls it at the start of its second part.
Loads banks 9 (S05_BG01) and 3 (S05_OBJ01) at once and banks 10 (S05_BG02) and 4 (S05_OBJ02) over frames. Chapter 5's stage program calls it at the start of its second part.
Frees banks 3 and 9 (bankFree). Chapter 5's stage program calls it in its third part at scroll position 1000.
Loads banks 4 (S05_OBJ02) and 10 (S05_BG02) at once. Chapter 5's stage program calls it at the start of its third part.

Sets chapter 5's light (its two angles, color 1, 1, 1 with intensity 1 and ambient 0.25, and for the multi-light models the color of light 1 and three more values of 0.5), and the fog's color to 75, 100, 155, its depths -70 and -500 (fogTableSet) and the fade's level 0.5, with byte 4 of ninjaFadeLevel at 0, and sets fogFadeOn. Chapter 5's stage program calls it at its start.
Shows the left band with bank 8's sprites 0x80000 to 0x80003 (leftBandCreate). Chapter 5's stage program calls it at scroll position 14625.

Shows four screen sprites (screenSpriteFade): 0x50000 at once for 280 frames, 0x50001 after 45 frames for 235, and 0x50002 and 0x50003 after 90 frames for 190, 20 to the left. Chapter 5's stage program calls it at scroll position 16300.
Starts chapter 5's music (sequencePlay 7) and plays sound 0x106. Chapter 5's stage program calls it at its start.
Fades the fog to color 70, 110, 150 with depths -70 and -500 in 360 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 5's stage program calls it at scroll position 16000.

Fades the lights in 300 frames (lightsFadeTo) to angles 0xE400 and 0x6900, the multi-light models' light 1 to color 1, 0.74, 0.54 and their three more values to 0.4, 0.5, 0.6. Chapter 5's stage program calls it.
Fades the fog to color 70, 110, 150 with depths -100 and -450 in 360 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 5's stage program calls it at the start of its third part.

Fades the lights in 300 frames (lightsFadeTo) to angles 0x8300 and 0x7200, with the same colors and values as ch5LightFade1, which runs before it, so only the angles change. Chapter 5's stage program calls it at the start of its third part.
Fades the fog to color 255, 140, 40 with depths -100 and -450 in 2500 frames (fogFadeTo). Chapter 5's stage program calls it in its third part.
Plays sound 0x3A (soundPlay). Chapter 5's stage program calls it at scroll position 14000.
Draws a ch5WarpFlash at its place: sprite 0x10903 at its size while that is above 0, and sprite 0x10904 at a random angle, both at its alpha with flags by its color.
The task of ch5WarpFlash: fades in by 8 a frame to 255 while its size shrinks, then fades out by 8 a frame while its second size eases down, and ends. Every 4 frames it picks a new random angle.
Makes a flash in list 3 (ch5WarpFlashUpdate, ch5WarpFlashDraw) at a place, white or black, where a ch5Warper appears.

The behaviour of ch5Warper's enemies: hidden and harmless for 32 frames, then it shows, aims at a ship (aimAtPlayer), can be hit and deals damage. After 33 more frames it speeds up along that aim by 0.0125 a frame up to 0.65 and ends once out of view.
Starts a ch5Warper: hidden (flag 0x01), still, immune to damage (hit flag 0x04) and harmless (power 0), aimed at a ship (aimAtPlayer), with a warp flash of its color at its place (ch5WarpFlash).
Makes an enemy with a node tree (enemyTreeCreate) that warps in and dashes at a ship (ch5WarperInit, ch5WarperMove).

The task of ch5Warpers: at its interval it makes a ch5Warper. With record byte 0x3B at 0 it picks a random place within 27.5 in x and 37.5 in y, every eighth at the ship's height, more than 25 from the ship, and after 33 failed tries it skips that one. With 1 it places them in turn on an ellipse of 27.5 by 37.5. Up to its frame count the interval falls by 1 each time to its least. After it the ellipse kind makes one more and ends, and the random kind raises the interval by 1 each time and ends once it passes 16. The intervals grow by half on easy and when a ship is lost.

A stage script's record function of chapter 5: makes a task in list 3 (ch5WarpersUpdate) that sends warping enemies. Record byte 0x3B gives its kind (0 random, 1 ellipse), bytes 0x39 and 0x3A its interval and least interval (half again on easy), the float at record word 6 its frame count, byte 0x38 its color, and record words 3 and 4 the start angle and step on the ellipse.

Draws a ch5CraftCreate enemy: model 0x20001 of bank 2 at its motion's frame, turned by its angles, and model 0x20002 on it with the second texture list when it is black. It files its hit record in list 3 while in view.

The task of a ch5CraftCreate enemy. At 0 hit points it calls enemyDestroyed, with two more explosions while it plays motion 1, plays sound 0x0C and ends. Else it runs its behaviour at 0x8C, ends when that returns nonzero, steps its motion, and places its muzzle and a point near it by its angle. After a shot (byte 0x68) it makes a flash (effectFlash).
Makes an enemy in list 3 (ch5CraftUpdate, ch5CraftDraw) with 10 hit points (enemyInit), with extra bytes of the given size at 0x94. The caller sets its behaviour at 0x8C.
Places a ch5RingCraft on its circle about the centre at its angle and radius.

The behaviour of ch5RingCraft's enemies: their circle turns by 0x200 a frame. Over 64 frames each comes forward from z 40 to 0, facing along the circle, and in the last 16 of them it turns to face the centre. For 121 frames it then fires a sprite bullet of its color toward the centre every 5 frames (bulletSpriteFireAt10508, speed 0.5). Then over 64 frames its radius grows from 25 to 55, in the first 15 of them it turns back almost along the circle, and it ends.
Makes a ch5CraftCreate enemy on a circle of 25 about the centre at an angle (ch5RingCraftMove), at the last frame of motion 1, which it later plays backward.
The task of ch5CraftRing: drops each of its 12 enemies once its task ends, and ends when none are left.
A stage script's record function of chapter 5: makes 12 ch5RingCraft enemies a twelfth of a turn apart and a task in list 3 (ch5CraftRingUpdate) that watches them.

The behaviour of ch5Diver's enemies: for 31 frames its y velocity rises by 0.05 a frame. From frame 5 to 61 it fires a sprite bullet of its color every 4 frames (bulletSpriteCreate10508), with its x velocity and with a y velocity of a quarter of its own less 0.875, give or take 0.125. Then it turns about x faster up to 0x300 a frame until its x angle passes -0x7800, moves in z faster up to 0.1 a frame, its y velocity rises by 0.025 a frame, and it ends once out of view.
A stage script's record function of chapter 5: makes a ch5CraftCreate enemy with the record's velocity that fires and then leaves (ch5DiverMove).
Draws a ch5GunshipCreate enemy as ch3GunshipDraw does, with model 0x20003 of bank 2.
The task of a ch5GunshipCreate enemy, as ch3GunshipUpdate with model 0x20003 of bank 2. At 0 hit points it calls enemyKill, plays sound 0x0D and ends.
Makes an enemy in list 3 (ch5GunshipUpdate, ch5GunshipDraw) with 20 hit points (enemyInit), with extra bytes of the given size at 0x13C. The caller sets its behaviour at 0x134.

The behaviour of ch5Gunship's enemies: over 64 frames it moves from the record's place to the place of record words 6 to 8 while it turns two full turns about z, and on its 32nd frame it starts attack mode 2 with 2 homing shots. When those are done it stops its attack. It waits 46 frames, then speeds away to its side by 0.025 a frame, rolling by 2048 times its x speed a frame, and ends once out of view.
A stage script's record function of chapter 5: makes a ch5GunshipCreate enemy that moves in and attacks (ch5GunshipMove), and plays sound 0x101.
Draws a ch5Cruiser: model 0x20000 of bank 2 at its motion's frame, turned a quarter turn about x and by its angles, and files its hit record in list 3 once it can be hit and while in view.
The task of ch5CruiserReturn: 60 frames later it makes another ch5Cruiser on the other side and ends. It ends without one once the scroll passes 13500.
Makes a task in list 3 (ch5CruiserReturnUpdate) with a copy of a ch5Cruiser's record, its side switched.
Makes 11 shards that spiral out from a destroyed ch5Cruiser (ch5Shard) and its return (ch5CruiserReturn).
The explosion of a destroyed ch5Cruiser: a burst of explosions (explosionBurst), its death bullets (enemyDeathBullets) and the kill for the chain (chainCount).

The task of a ch5Cruiser. At 0 hit points it bursts (ch5CruiserBurst), plays sound 0x0D, breaks (ch5CruiserBreak) and ends. Else it comes in from the depth over 86 frames, rolling a full turn. From its 65th frame, on which it plays sound 0x100, it can be hit and fires four-way sprite bullets of its color on every second frame from two points (bulletSpriteFireAt10504). It sways from side to side, and after the come-in it also fires four turning bullets a frame at random angles below it from two more points (bulletSpinFireAt). Once the scroll passes 13750 it rises away, faster by 0.00675 a frame, and ends out of view.
Stops a ch5Cruiser's sound when its task ends.

A stage script's record function of chapter 5: makes a cruiser in list 3 (ch5CruiserUpdate, ch5CruiserDraw) with 240 hit points (enemyInit), its side from record byte 0x39, keeping a copy of the record for its return, and plays sound 0x100.
Places a ch5Shard at its distance from its centre along its angle.

The behaviour of ch5Shard's enemies: from their 17th frame they can be hit. While in view they spiral out, their distance growing by 0.1625 and their angle by 0x180 a frame, and they end once out of view.
Makes an enemy with model 0x10003 (enemyModel3Create) at a distance of 6.25 from a destroyed ch5Cruiser at an angle, which spirals out (ch5ShardMove), without a hit record at first.
Starts chapter 5's first stage script, at 0x8C0EAE0C (scriptStart). The stage program calls it at its start.
Steps the frame of a shape motion of chapter 5's boss (the table at 0x8C107678) by a speed. At the motion's last frame it wraps with flag 1, else it stays there and returns 1.

Shows three screen sprites (screenSpriteFade): 0x50004 at once for 240 frames, and 0x50005 and 0x50006 after 45 frames for 195, 12 to the left. ch5BossUpdate calls it at the end of the boss's first phase.

Shows three screen sprites (screenSpriteFade): 0x50007 at once for 240 frames, and 0x50008 and 0x50009 after 45 frames for 195, 40 to the left. ch5BossUpdate calls it at the end of the boss's second phase.
Keeps the matrix of chapter 5's boss's node 1 at 0x4C4, where ch5BossDraw draws the first phase's four parts.

The function of chapter 5's boss's node 1: keeps its matrix (ch5BossMatrixParts) and places the 16 fire points of the first phase's parts (the table at 0x8C10769C, four for each part) at 0x6C on the play field.
Places the 12 points of chapter 5's boss's core (the table at 0x8C10775C) at 0x1B4 on the play field, where the lasers start (ch5BossLaserFan).
The function of chapter 5's boss's node 3: keeps its matrix at 0x504, where ch5BossDraw draws the second phase's first part once it is destroyed.
The function of chapter 5's boss's node 4: keeps its matrix at 0x544, where ch5BossDraw draws the second phase's second part once it is destroyed.
The function of chapter 5's boss's node 20, set at the start of the third phase: keeps its matrix at 0x584, where ch5BossDraw draws the core.
The function of chapter 5's boss's node 21, set at the start of the third phase: keeps its matrix at 0x5C4, where ch5BossDraw draws the shape motion (ch5BossShapeDraw).
Draws chapter 5's boss's shape motion (njCnkEasyMultiDrawShapeMotion) at its frame (0x1AC), with the motion that byte 0x1AA picks from the tables at 0x8C107678, 0x8C107684 and 0x8C107690.

Draws chapter 5's boss and keeps its matrix at 0x244. In the second phase it files the armoured record at 0x444 and its two parts, places their points at 0x140, and, while the record of the first part (0x3C4) is not armoured, lights a light (lightOn) at a live part that is hit. It draws its node tree (model 0x30000) at its motion's frame. In the first phase it files the armoured body at 0x384 and the four parts, draws the parts (model 0x30003, model 0x30004 once destroyed) and places the live parts' centres at 0x3C. Destroyed parts of the second phase are model 0x30005. In the third phase it places the core's 12 points (ch5BossLaserPoints), draws the core (model 0x30006) turned by 0x16C, 0x168 and 0x170, files it, and draws the shape motion (ch5BossShapeDraw).

A burst at chapter 5's boss: a shock ring (shockRingFire), an explosion, a ring of 10 explosions (explosionRing) and particles. It is at the boss's x, z 20, and at y 20 with 0 or the boss's y with 1. ch5BossUpdate calls it at the end of each phase.

Starts 12 lasers of chapter 5's boss (ch5BossLaserChargeCreate) at the core's 12 points, in the core's color (0x11 white, 0x22 black): the first six at angles 0xA400 down to 0x7980, the other six at 0x5C00 up to 0x8680, 0x880 apart.

The behaviour of chapter 5's boss's drones in the first phase (ch5BossDroneCreate). It moves from x -25 (side 0) or 25, y 15, z 20 to y 17.5, z 0 over 128 frames, aimed at a ship.
